ProjectDamagePreferences.preset_ui:
Choose Preset Interface. Legacy UI: Standard Blender thumbnail selector; Advanced UI: GPU preset browser with search, scrolling and Shift zoom.
Legacy UI: Standard Blender thumbnail selector.
Advanced UI: GPU preset browser with search, scrolling and Shift zoom.
ProjectDamagePreferences.editorial_mode:
Show documentation buttons beside Geometry section titles.
Off: hide the documentation buttons.
On: open the matching local manual page from each section.
ProjectDamagePreferences.enable_hints:
Show rendered-example help buttons beside complex controls. Ordinary hover tooltips remain available.
Off: hide the image-help buttons.
On: show the buttons and their comparison popups.
ProjectDamagePreferences.experimental_ma:
Put each material beside the Geometry feature that creates its faces.
Off: retain the separate Material tab.
On: move region materials into Geometry and use Damage UV for UV tools.
ProjectDamagePreferences.material_librar:
Folder where you unpacked the Project Damage material pack.
Empty: the addon looks for the pack in its usual place and offers a download if it is missing.
Assigned: materials are loaded from this folder.

Enable Material Library Enabled for this object.
Off: omit material library enabled while keeping its stored settings.
On: use material library enabled with the controls below.

Web link to the separate material pack. It is shown as a download button when the pack is not found.
Empty: no download button is offered.
Assigned: the button opens this link.
ProjectDamagePreferences.core_dir:
Folder with the compiled engine of the addon. Only needed when you test your own build.
Empty: the engine shipped inside the addon is used.
Assigned: the engine is loaded from this folder instead.
ProjectDamagePreferences.manual_dir:
Folder with the built manual pages. Only needed when you keep the manual somewhere else.
Empty: the manual shipped inside the addon is opened.
Assigned: the manual is opened from this folder.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_mode:
Procedural samples triangles by area. Paint projects closed regions and accepts cutters only inside them.
Low / first state: Procedural scatters over eligible source faces.
High / other state: Paint requires a valid contour; radii shrink near its boundary and depth is capped against local wall thickness.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_path:
A black and white image that shapes the broken surface. White sticks out, black sinks in.
Empty: the built-in gravel image is used.
Assigned: your own image shapes the break.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_scale:
How big one repeat of the image is on the surface, in cm.
Low: small, busy texture detail.
High: large, stretched-out texture detail.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_strength:
How deep the image presses into the broken surface, in cm.
0: the image is ignored, only the built-in bumps remain.
High: deep, rough relief from the image.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_edge:
Target triangle size inside the source. 0 uses Texture Scale / 60. Increase for faster updates and fewer triangles.
Minimum: At zero use the automatic size described above; small positive sizes produce fine, heavier geometry.
Maximum: Larger cells or edges: coarser, faster geometry that may lose small features.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_exit:
Refinement multiplier near the boundary where the break exits the source; higher is denser and slower.
Minimum: Coarser, faster geometry with less small detail.
Maximum: Finer, heavier geometry; the active geometry budget may limit the requested detail.
Allowed range: 1 to 8.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.smooth_slope:
Like Concrete Damage V2: the opening flares out where the break meets the surface, so the break wall runs into it as a gentle slope instead of an edge (no rim chips on it).
Off: omit smooth slope while keeping its stored settings.
On: use smooth slope with the controls below.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.smooth_width:
How wide the soft slope at the border of the breaker is, compared with the breaker size.
Low: a short, steep step into the break.
High (1): a long gentle ramp across the whole breaker.
Allowed range: 0.02 to 1.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_macro:
Bottom layer: the procedural break surface (the same as Procedural mode) under the image displacement; 1 = the Procedural shape, 0 = only the texture.
Minimum: Only the texture.
Maximum: The procedural shape, 0 = only the texture.
Allowed range: 0 to 4.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_offset_x:
X translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative X.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive X. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_offset_y:
Y translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Y.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Y. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.tex_offset_z:
Z translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Z.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Z. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.cutter:
Any object of your own that is used as the cutting shape.
Empty: nothing is cut by this breaker.
Assigned: the object is carved out of the surface.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.custom_sheet:
Choose Open Mesh. Cut One Side: Cut the side the sheet normals face; Slab: Thicken the sheet using Thickness.
Cut One Side: Cut the side the sheet normals face.
Slab: Thicken the sheet using Thickness.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.rebar:
Enable Expose Rebar for this object.
Off: omit expose rebar while keeping its stored settings.
On: use expose rebar with the controls below.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.is_breaker:
Enable is breaker for this object.
Off: omit is breaker while keeping its stored settings.
On: use is breaker with the controls below.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.enabled:
Enable Enabled for this object.
Off: omit enabled while keeping its stored settings.
On: use enabled with the controls below.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.mode:
Choose Mode. Plane: One noisy break face closed by a skirt; Sphere: A closed noisy ball, for a local bite; Strip: Two break faces a Thickness apart.
Plane: One noisy break face closed by a skirt.
Sphere: A closed noisy ball, for a local bite.
Strip: Two break faces a Thickness apart.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.flip:
Enable Invert for this object.
Off: omit invert while keeping its stored settings.
On: use invert with the controls below.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.seed:
Shuffles the bumps of the broken surface without changing their size.
Every number gives a different random surface.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.length:
Length of the breaker shape.
Low: a short cut.
High: a long cut.
Allowed range: 1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.width:
Width of the breaker shape.
Low: a narrow cut.
High: a wide cut.
Allowed range: 1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.thickness:
Thickness of the breaker shape, which is how deep it can bite.
Low: a thin slice is removed.
High: a thick block is removed.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.radius:
Radius of the round breaker.
Low: a small bite.
High: a large bite.
Allowed range: 1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.resolution:
Sampling density used to build the break surface.
Minimum: Coarser, faster geometry with less small detail.
Maximum: Finer, heavier geometry; the active geometry budget may limit the requested detail.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.strength:
How strongly the broken surface is pushed in and out.
0%: a perfectly smooth cut.
High (400%): a very rough, lumpy break.
Allowed range: 0% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.macro_h:
Height of the big hills and hollows on the broken surface.
0%: no big shapes, a flat break.
High (50%): strong large lumps.
Allowed range: 0% to 50%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.turb_h:
Height of the medium ridges and creases on the broken surface.
0%: no ridges.
High (50%): strongly creased, torn-looking surface.
Allowed range: 0% to 50%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.fine_h:
Height of the fine grain on the broken surface.
0%: no grain, smooth between the big shapes.
High (50%): a coarse, sandy surface.
Allowed range: 0% to 50%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.noise_scale:
Overall size of all bumps on the broken surface.
Low (25%): small, tight bumps.
High (400%): big, sweeping shapes.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.rim_amp:
How much the outline of the break is chewed in and out.
0%: a clean, even outline.
High (50%): a deeply ragged outline.
Allowed range: 0% to 50%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.rim_scale:
Size of the bites along the outline of the break.
Low (25%): many small nicks.
High (400%): a few big waves.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_smooth:
Softens the break surface: fewer and weaker fine octaves, rounded instead of sharp ridges. 0 = the original surface.
Minimum: Retain sharper local changes.
Maximum: Round or average more local variation.
Allowed range: 0 to 1.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_detail:
Tessellation of the crater or knife cutter. The host also multiplies it by Master Quality.
Minimum: 25% is coarse and cheaper.
Maximum: 400% resolves more of the procedural outline; this does not increase Amount.
Allowed range: 1 to 8.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_roughness:
How much small detail is piled on top of the big shapes.
Low: soft, rounded lumps.
High: harsh, gritty surface full of small detail.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 0.95.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_crease:
Turbulence layer: 1 = sharp ridges and creases (the original), 0 = rounded bumps.
Minimum: Rounded bumps.
Maximum: Sharp ridges and creases (the original), 0 = rounded bumps.
Allowed range: 0 to 1.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.surf_warp:
Swirls the bumps so they look less regular.
0: plain, even bumps.
High (4): stretched, flowing, twisted shapes.
Allowed range: 0 to 4.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.macro_scale:
Size of the big hills and hollows only.
Low (25%): many small hills.
High (400%): one or two huge swells.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.turb_scale:
Size of the medium ridges and creases only.
Low (25%): tight, busy creases.
High (400%): long, wide ridges.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageBreakerProps.fine_scale:
Size of the fine grain only.
Low (25%): very fine sand.
High (400%): coarse pebbly grain.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.wallhole_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit wall hole (bricks) while keeping its stored settings.
On: use wall hole (bricks) with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.background_compute:
Run native generation in a separate process so Blender stays usable. Preparation and applying the result still run on the main thread. Uses more memory; native caches are not shared with the worker.
Off: omit background calculation while keeping its stored settings.
On: use background calculation with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.ivy_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit ivy generator while keeping its stored settings.
On: use ivy generator with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.roots_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit roots generator while keeping its stored settings.
On: use roots generator with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.perf_prep_cache:
Reuse prepared geometry while mesh coordinates, topology, triangulation, unit scale, preparation settings and backend are unchanged. Disable to clear this source cache and prepare every update. Limited to 8 sources / 256 MiB.
Off: omit mesh prep cache while keeping its stored settings.
On: use mesh prep cache with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.perf_mesh_preparation:
Optimized orientation, local-piece solidification and duplicate restoration. Disable to use original mesh preparation; no quality reduction.
Off: omit mesh preparation while keeping its stored settings.
On: use mesh preparation with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.perf_ngon_restore:
Restore untouched n-gons in independent batches instead of one operator per n-gon; preserves UVs and materials.
Off: omit n-gon restore while keeping its stored settings.
On: use n-gon restore with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.performance_optimizat:
Use optimized multi-piece mesh preparation and batched n-gon restoration for this source. Disable to use the original algorithms. Does not lower quality or change effect settings.
Off: omit performance optimization while keeping its stored settings.
On: use performance optimization with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.glass_drawn_enable:
Draw a closed region with Grease Pencil (Broken Glass > Holes): there is no glass inside it, and the impact cracks run from its rim across the whole pane. Shares the Broken Glass settings.
Off: omit broken glass drawn while keeping its stored settings.
On: use broken glass drawn with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.glass_drawn_reach:
How far the radial cracks run from the drawn hole, times its radius (0.5 and up, default 8 = across a pane). It replaces the Crack Reach of the Cracks section.
Low (2): short cracks round the hole.
High (8 or 16): the cracks run to the edges of the pane.
Allowed range: 0.5 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.glass_hit_enable:
Bullet / stone hits in glass at the empties of the Hit Glass collection: hole, radial cracks and rings, like Broken Glass impacts. Shares the Broken Glass settings.
Off: omit hit glass while keeping its stored settings.
On: use hit glass with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.glass_hit_collection: The collection with the hit Empties. The + button next to it adds an Empty at the 3D cursor; if no collection is set yet, it creates "<object> | Glass Impacts" and links it. Move the Empties close to the glass. Without Empties nothing is cut and a warning is shown. No image: the hero image shows two hits.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_v2_enable:
Concrete Damage with a smooth profile: one bowl easing into the surface, no steep walls or ledges. Shares the Concrete Damage settings.
Off: omit concrete damage v2 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use concrete damage v2 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_v2_enable:
Lath and Plaster with a smooth profile: the broken plaster eases into the surface, no steep walls or ledges. Shares the Lath and Plaster settings.
Off: omit lath and plaster v2 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use lath and plaster v2 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_profile:
internal: set from the Lath V2 tile.
Minimum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Maximum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_riven_enable:
Hand-split lath nailed to studs: wavy, uneven boards, joints on the studs, snapped boards hanging in holes. Shares the Lath and Plaster settings.
Off: omit riven lath while keeping its stored settings.
On: use riven lath with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_framing_enable:
Drywall or plaster skin broken away over a timber stud frame: studs, plates, noggins and nails, snapped members in holes. No laths. Shares the outline, plaster, hole and crack settings of Lath and Plaster.
Off: omit stud framing while keeping its stored settings.
On: use stud framing with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_style:
internal: set from the Riven Lath and Stud Framing tiles.
Minimum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Maximum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_smooth_width:
How wide the soft slope from the hole into the untouched wall is, compared with the patch size.
Low: a short, steep edge.
High (1): a long, gentle slope.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 1.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_v2_enable:
Brick Damage with a smooth profile: the render eases into the surface, no sharp edge, steep walls or ledges. Shares the Brick Damage settings.
Off: omit brick damage v2 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use brick damage v2 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_profile:
internal: set from the Brick V2 tile.
Minimum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Maximum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_smooth_width:
Share of the patch radius the slope spans (0.05 to 1, default 0.75).
Low (0.1): a steep rim; the bricks show over most of the patch.
High (1): a shallow bowl; only a few bricks show.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 1.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_profile:
internal: set from the Concrete Damage V2 tile.
Minimum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Maximum: Compatibility value; not an artistic intensity control in the current asset.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_smooth_width:
In the General box: the share of the patch radius the slope spans (0.05 to 1, default 0.75). Larger values give a gentler transition.
Low (0.1): a short slope; the patch keeps a clear rim and a wide, flat floor.
High (1): the slope runs over the whole patch; a faint, shallow dip.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 1.
ProjectDamageProps.ui_section:
Choose Settings. Geometry: Geometry and drawing controls; Material: Assign materials to generated regions.
Geometry: Geometry and drawing controls.
Material: Assign materials to generated regions.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_skin_depth:
Maximum distance used to associate opposite faces with the same cloth panel.
Minimum (0): only the connected surface side is affected.
Maximum: allow a thicker panel back to belong to the same tear; excessive values may include a nearby panel.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_holes_en:
Draw only. Turns strokes of the holes drawing into holes. A stroke gives a hole along it, a closed loop a hole of that shape
Off: drawn holes are not used
On: the strokes are cut into the cloth as holes
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_edges_en:
Draw only. Turns strokes that start at the border of the cloth into torn slits
off: drawn torn edges are not used
On: slits are cut along the strokes
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_only:
Use only the drawn contours: no automatic holes or border tears. An empty drawing leaves the cloth intact. Turn off to combine automatic and drawn tears.
Off: omit draw only while keeping its stored settings.
On: use draw only with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_jagged:
Raggedness of the rim of drawn holes, as a share of Rim Detail Size.
Low (0): smooth, clean-cut rims.
High: ragged, torn rims.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_rag_size:
Size of the bumps of the ragged rim.
Low: fine, small raggedness.
High: large, coarse bites in the rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_edge_spa:
Draw only. Distance between the slits cut along a torn edge stroke
Low: many slits close together
High: few, widely spaced slits
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_edge_len:
Draw only. Shortest drawn edge slit. Keep it at or below Length Max
low: short nicks are possible
High: every slit is long
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Draw only. Longest drawn edge slit. Keep it at or above Length Min
Low: only short nicks
High: long slits deep into the cloth are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_edge_wid:
Draw only. Narrowest drawn edge slit. Keep it at or below Width Max
Low: thin cuts are possible
high: every slit is wide
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Draw only. Widest drawn edge slit. Keep it at or above Width Min
Low: only thin cuts
High: wide V-shaped gaps are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_paint_hang_spa:
Distance between loose threads hanging from a tear you drew, in cm.
Low: a dense fringe of threads.
High: only a few threads far apart.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_enable:
Turns Concrete Hit on: the impact of a heavy blow at each empty, a crushed crater, broken skin plates and cracks
Off: no impacts
On: one impact per empty in Impact Empties
ProjectDamageProps.hit_seed:
Changes the random pattern of plates and cracks without changing their size.
Every number gives a different arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_avoid:
Keeps impacts away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: impacts may land on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_detail:
Polygon density of the plates, crater and cracks.
Low: coarse plates and blocky cracks, fast updates.
High: crisp cracks and a finely broken crater, heavy mesh.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_aim:
Choose Aim. Nearest Surface; Arrow +Z.
Nearest Surface: select this aim variant.
Arrow +Z: select this aim variant.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radius_scale:
Multiplies the radius of every impact empty at once.
Low: smaller damage zones than the empties.
High: larger damage zones.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_proximity:
How far from the surface an impact empty may be and still leave a mark, compared with its radius.
Low: only empties touching the surface count.
High: empties far away still leave a weaker mark.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_prox_shrink:
0.1 how much a weak (far) hit also shrinks, not just shallows.
Minimum: Distant impacts keep their full radius while their depth fades.
Maximum: Distant impacts shrink in radius as well as becoming shallower.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_oblique:
aim == 1: stretch of the hit along the shot direction.
Minimum: A near-round impact footprint.
Maximum: A more elongated footprint along the shot direction; used in directional aiming.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_layer_thickness:
Depth of the shattered outer skin, in cm.
Low: a thin skin, the plates are flakes.
High: thick plates with deep gaps between them.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to 10.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_core_size:
Size of the crushed centre, x radius.
Low: a small crater.
High: a large crater that takes most of the zone.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_core_depth:
Depth of the crater below the skin, x radius.
Low: a shallow dent.
High: a deep crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_core_jagged:
Raggedness of the crater rim.
Low (0): a smooth elliptic rim.
High: a ragged, broken rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_roughness:
Unevenness of the crater floor (shape, not shader roughness).
Low (0): a smooth crater floor.
High: a rough, broken floor.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_aggregate_size:
Size of the pits in the crater floor, in cm, like exposed aggregate.
Low: a fine, sandy floor.
High: coarse pits like large gravel.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_thickness_cap:
The deepest the damage may cut, as a share of the local wall thickness. Protects thin walls.
Low: the damage stays shallow on thin walls.
High: the damage may cut almost through. On the 20 cm test wall the crater never reaches the cap.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_hole_enable:
Punches a hole through the wall in the crater centre.
Off: a crater with a floor.
On: a through-hole in the middle of the crater.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_hole_size:
Size of the through-hole compared with the crater.
Low: a small hole in the crater floor.
High: a hole as large as the crater. On the 20 cm and 3 cm test walls no through-hole appeared with Hole Enable on, so these two settings have no image.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_plate_size:
Typical plate diameter at the rim of the zone, x radius.
Low: many small plates.
High: a few large plates.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_plate_growth:
How much the plates get smaller toward the centre.
Low (0): plates of the same size everywhere.
High (1): large plates at the rim, small fragments near the crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_zone_jagged:
Irregularity of the outer outline of the shatter zone.
Low (0): a round zone.
High: a ragged, uneven zone outline.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_shatter:
Share of plates knocked out, more near the crater.
Low (0): all plates stay in place, only cracked.
High (1): most plates are gone, the zone is a shallow hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_tilt:
How far the remaining plates are pushed in and tilted, x Layer Thickness.
Low (0): flat plates, flush with the wall.
High: plates pushed in and tilted unevenly.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_edge_jagged:
Irregularity of the plate edges.
Low (0): straight plate edges.
High: rough, broken plate edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_chip:
Small bites out of the plate rims.
Low (0): clean plate rims.
High: heavily chipped rims.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_crack_enable:
Adds radial cracks and crack rings around the shatter zone
Off: only the plates and the crater
On: cracks run out into the wall
ProjectDamageProps.hit_crack_width:
Width of the crack grooves.
Low: hairline cracks.
High: wide, open cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_crack_depth:
Depth of the crack grooves.
Low: shallow surface cracks.
High: deep cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radial_count:
Number of radial cracks running out of the zone.
Low (0): no radial cracks.
High: a star of many cracks.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radial_length_min:
Shortest radial crack, x radius. Keep it at or below Radial Length Max
Low: short cracks close to the zone are possible
High: every crack reaches far
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radial_length_max:
Longest radial crack, x radius. Keep it at or above Radial Length Min
Low: only short cracks
high: long cracks far into the wall are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radial_meander:
How much the radial cracks wander.
Low (0): straight cracks.
High: winding cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_radial_branch:
Chance of a fork on each radial crack.
Low (0): single cracks.
High (1): every crack forks once. The forks are short and hard to see at page size.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_ring_count:
Number of concentric crack rings outside the zone.
Low (0): no rings.
High: several rings around the impact.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.hit_ring_fill:
Share of each ring that is actually cracked.
Low: short ring pieces.
High (1): complete rings.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_enable:
Turns Plaster Displacement on: hand-trowelled plaster relief with strokes, ridges, grain and hairline cracks. It changes the relief, it does not cut holes
Off: the wall stays flat
On: the surface is subdivided and displaced
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_seed:
Changes the random pattern of strokes and cracks without changing their size.
Every number gives a different arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_avoid:
Keeps plaster damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: plaster may break on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay smooth.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_edge_length:
Target edge length used to resolve trowel displacement.
Minimum: fine, heavier topology that resolves narrower strokes.
Maximum: coarse, faster topology that can flatten small marks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_max_tris:
The triangle budget of the subdivided mesh. Resolution is lowered automatically to stay under it.
Low: a light mesh; large walls lose detail.
High: full detail on large walls, slow updates.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_detail:
Density of the subdivided mesh that carries the relief.
Low: soft, blurry relief and missing fine grain, fast updates.
High: sharp ridges and fine grain, heavy mesh.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_strength:
Height of the relief from the lowest to the highest trowel level, in cm.
Low: a barely textured wall.
High: a heavy, rustic relief.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_sink:
Whether the relief builds outward or inward from the original surface.
Low (0): the plaster only builds outward.
High (1): the relief only goes into the wall. The look is the same, only the level shifts.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_thickness_cap:
The deepest the relief may go into the wall, as a share of the local wall thickness. Protects thin walls.
Low: the relief stays shallow on thin walls.
High: no limit on the test wall; it only matters on very thin walls.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_undulation:
Broad waviness under the strokes, x Strength.
Low (0): a flat wall under the strokes.
High: the whole wall swells and dips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_undulation_sc:
Size of the waves of the undulation, in cm (images use Undulation 1).
Low: short, bumpy waves.
High: long, gentle waves.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_coats:
Number of layers of strokes (0 to 6).
Low (0): no strokes, only undulation, grain and cracks.
High: many overlapping layers, a busy surface.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_coverage:
Stroke area per coat compared with the wall area.
Low: separate strokes with flat wall between them.
High: the strokes cover the wall several times over.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_length_min:
Shortest stroke along the trowel motion, in cm. Keep it at or below Length Max
Low: short dabs are possible
High: every stroke is long
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_length_max:
Longest stroke along the trowel motion, in cm. Keep it at or above Length Min
low: only short dabs
High: long sweeping strokes are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_width_min:
Narrowest stroke (the trowel blade), in cm. Keep it at or below Width Max
Low: narrow strokes are possible
High: every stroke is wide
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_width_max:
Widest stroke (the trowel blade), in cm. Keep it at or above Width Min
Low: only narrow strokes
high: wide strokes are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_angle:
Direction of the strokes, in degrees from horizontal (images use Angle Random and Cross Chance 0).
0°: horizontal strokes.
90°: vertical strokes.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_angle_random:
Random spread of the stroke direction (1 = up to 90° each way).
Low (0): all strokes parallel.
High (1): strokes in all directions.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_cross_chance:
Share of strokes turned by 90°, for cross-hatched trowelling.
Low (0): all strokes in the main direction.
High (1): strokes in both directions.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_curve:
How much a stroke bends into an arc.
Low (0): straight strokes.
High (1): strongly curved, fan-like strokes.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_flatten:
How hard a stroke levels the plaster below it.
Low (0): strokes add relief but do not smooth what is under them.
High: each stroke presses a flat patch into the surface.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_tilt:
Change of level along a stroke, like the trowel pitch, x Strength.
Low (0): every stroke is level.
High: strokes slope noticeably from one end to the other.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_jagged:
Raggedness of the stroke outline.
Low (0): smooth stroke edges.
High: ragged, torn stroke edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_streaks:
Drag lines along the stroke, x Strength.
Low (0): smooth stroke surfaces.
High: strong striations along each stroke.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_ridge_height:
Height of the ridge, x Strength.
Low (0): no ridges, strokes blend into each other.
High: tall, pronounced ridges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_ridge_width:
How far the ridge spreads past the stroke rim, in cm.
Low: a thin, narrow lip.
High: a broad, soft ridge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_ridge_sharp:
Profile of the ridge.
Low (0): a soft, rounded bead.
High: a crisp, knife-cut lip.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_ridge_trail:
Where along the stroke rim the ridge forms.
Low (0): an even ridge all round the stroke.
High: a ridge only at the trailing end, where the trowel lifted.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_grain:
Height of the fine surface roughness, in cm.
Low (0): smooth plaster.
High: a sandy, coarse surface. Only visible when Grain Size is large enough for the mesh (see Grain Size).
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_grain_size:
Size of the grain bumps, in cm (images use Grain 0.12). Grain finer than about two mesh edges fades out, so it needs a high Resolution.
Low: fine sand. Grain smaller than the mesh can carry is faded out, so at the default 0.3 cm it was not visible on the test wall.
High: coarse lumps (clearly visible at 1 cm).
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_pits:
Share of small pits and air holes in the grain.
Low (0): no pits.
High (1): a porous, pitted surface.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_enable:
Adds a network of fine shrinkage cracks
Off: no cracks
On: hairline cracks over the plaster
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_amount:
Density of the crack network.
Low: a few isolated cracks.
High: a dense network.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_scale:
Typical size of a crack cell, in cm.
Low: small cells, a fine crazing.
High: large cells, long cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_width:
Width of the crack grooves.
Low: hairlines.
High: open cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_depth:
Depth of the crack grooves.
Low: barely visible cracks.
High: deep cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_meander:
Side-to-side wandering of the cracks.
Low (0): straight cracks.
High: winding cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_breakup:
How often a crack fades out along its run.
Low (0): continuous cracks.
High: broken, interrupted cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_step:
Height offset between the two sides of a crack, in cm.
Low (0): both sides level.
High: one side of the crack stands higher, a stepped crack.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_crack_lip:
A raised, smeared filler bead beside the crack, x Crack Depth.
Low (0): a clean crack.
High: a crack with a raised, filled lip, like a repaired crack.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_up_x:
X component of the up direction of the wall. Horizontal strokes and Angle are measured from it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along X
1: the direction points along X (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_up_y:
Y component of the up direction of the wall. Horizontal strokes and Angle are measured from it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along Y
1: the direction points along Y (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.plaster_up_z:
Z component of the up direction of the wall. Horizontal strokes and Angle are measured from it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along Z
1: the direction points along Z (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_enable:
Turns torn and splintered wood on for this object.
Off: no wood damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: wood tears, splits and knots are added.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_seed:
Shuffles where the wood tears land and how they look, without changing size or amount.
Every number gives a different random arrangement.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_mode:
Choose Mode. Automatic; Paint.
Automatic: select this mode variant.
Paint: select this mode variant.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_avoid:
Keeps wood damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: tears may land on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_detail:
cutter grid resolution (0.25.4).
Minimum: Coarser, faster geometry with less small detail.
Maximum: Finer, heavier geometry; the active geometry budget may limit the requested detail.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_grain_mode:
Choose Grain Mode. Automatic per Part; Fixed Axis.
Automatic per Part: select this grain mode variant.
Fixed Axis: select this grain mode variant.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_grain_x:
Local-space X component of grain. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative X.
Maximum: Point toward positive X. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_grain_y:
Local-space Y component of grain. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Y.
Maximum: Point toward positive Y. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_grain_z:
Local-space Z component of grain. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Z.
Maximum: Point toward positive Z. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_amount:
Number of torn patches on the wood.
0: no torn patches.
High: many torn patches, as long as there is room for them.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_size_min:
Smallest width of a torn patch across the grain, in cm.
Low: some patches are tiny.
High: even the smallest patch is big.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_size_max:
Largest width of a torn patch across the grain, in cm.
Low: all patches stay small.
High: some patches grow large.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_lobes:
1.8 overlapping blobs per patch.
Minimum: A simple, single-lobe damage outline.
Maximum: More overlapping lobes and a more irregular outline.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_stretch:
elongation ALONG the grain (1 = round).
Minimum: Rounder damage patches.
Maximum: Longer tears aligned with the wood grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_end_bias:
0.1 pull toward plank ends (edges across the grain).
Minimum: No extra preference for plank ends.
Maximum: Prefer edges across the grain at board ends.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_edge_bias:
0.1 pull toward any sharp edge (plank sides).
Minimum: No extra preference for sharp source edges.
Maximum: Concentrate damage near suitable sharp edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_paint_radius:
How wide the damage is along a line you drew, in cm.
Low: a thin torn strip.
High: a wide torn band.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_paint_snap:
How far from the surface a drawn line may be and still count, in cm.
Low: only lines drawn right on the wood are used.
High: lines floating far off the wood are used too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_paint_close:
How big a gap between the two ends of a drawn line is closed automatically, compared with the line length.
0: only lines you closed yourself become patches.
High: almost any curved line is closed into a patch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_depth_min:
Shallowest depth of a tear, in cm.
Low: some tears barely scratch the surface.
High: even the shallowest tear is deep.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_depth_max:
Deepest depth of a tear, in cm.
Low: all tears stay shallow.
High: some tears go deep into the board.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_layers:
Number of fibre layers a tear steps down through.
Low (1): one flat torn layer.
High (6): a staircase of splintered layers.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_layer_inset:
How far each deeper layer starts behind the one above it.
Low: layers end almost at the same place.
High: wide steps between the layers.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_fiber_depth_var:
How much the depth differs from one fibre strip to the next.
0: an even torn floor.
1: a bumpy floor with strips at different depths.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_thickness_cap:
Stops tears from going too deep into thin boards, as a share of the board thickness.
0: no limit, tears may reach the back.
High: tears may use more of the board thickness.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_jagged:
How ragged the outline of a tear is.
0: a clean, smooth outline.
High: a torn, irregular outline.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_fiber_width:
Width of one fibre strip across the grain, in cm.
Low: fine, hair-thin fibres.
High: wide, chunky strips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_fiber_jitter:
How much the strip widths differ from each other.
0: all strips have the same width.
1: thin and wide strips mixed.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_splinter_length:
How far the pointed splinter ends reach along the grain, in cm.
Low: short, stubby ends.
High: long, sharp splinters.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_splinter_sharp:
Shape of the splinter ends.
0: blunt, square ends.
1: needle-sharp points.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_splinter_chunk:
How often neighbouring strips break off together.
0: every strip breaks on its own.
1: wide chunks break off as one.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_splinter_ramp:
How gradually the fibres rise toward their tips.
0: the fibres end with a sharp step.
1: the fibres peel up in a long slope.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_floor_fibers:
0.1 fibrous ridges on the torn floor.
Minimum: A cleaner torn floor.
Maximum: More pronounced fibrous ridges along the grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_groove_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit groove enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use groove enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_groove_spacing:
Distance between the growth-ring grooves in the torn wood, in cm.
Low: dense, fine grain lines.
High: a few wide-apart lines.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_groove_depth:
Depth of the grain grooves, in cm.
0: no grooves, a smooth torn floor.
High: deep, clearly visible grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_groove_wave:
How wavy the grain lines are.
0: dead straight lines.
High: strongly curving grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_groove_breakup:
How much the grooves fade in and out along their length.
0: continuous grooves.
1: broken, patchy grooves.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_weather_halo:
Width of the weathered ring around each tear, compared with the patch size.
0: weathering only inside the tear.
High: a wide worn zone around each tear.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_break_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit break enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use break enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_break_chance:
Share of tears that go right through the board.
0: no tear breaks through.
1: every tear has a hole through the board.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_break_size:
How much of a tear is open all the way through.
Low: a small hole in the middle of the tear.
High: almost the whole tear is a hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit check enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use check enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_amount:
Number of long splits running out of each tear along the grain.
0: no splits.
High: many splits fan out of every tear.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_global:
Number of extra splits spread over the whole surface, away from the tears.
0: none.
High: a board covered in drying splits.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_length_min:
Shortest split, in cm.
Low: some splits are very short.
High: even the shortest split is long.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_length_max:
Longest split, in cm.
Low: all splits stay short.
High: some splits run far along the board.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_width:
How wide a split opens at the surface, in cm.
Low: hairline splits.
High: wide open gaps.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_depth:
How deep the splits go, in cm.
Low: shallow surface splits.
High: deep splits; watch thin boards.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_check_meander:
How much a split wanders from side to side.
0: dead straight along the grain.
High: a winding, wavy split.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_knot_amount:
Number of knot holes on the whole surface.
0: no knot holes.
High: many knot holes.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_knot_size:
Size of a knot hole across the grain, in cm.
Low: small pin knots.
High: large knot holes.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_knot_stretch:
elongation along the grain.
Minimum: Rounder knots.
Maximum: Knots elongated along the grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_knot_depth:
How deep the knot holes go, in cm.
Low: shallow dimples.
High: deep holes; watch thin boards.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_knot_checks:
short splits out of each knot.
Minimum: No or few splits around knots.
Maximum: More short splits emitted around each knot.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit sliver enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use sliver enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_amount:
Share of fibre strips that leave a loose sliver sticking out.
0: no slivers.
1: a sliver on every strip.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_length:
Length of the loose slivers, in cm.
Low: short stubs.
High: long, thin slivers.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_width:
Width of the loose slivers, in cm. Never wider than the fibre strip.
Low: hair-thin slivers.
High: wide, flat slivers.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_thick:
Set Sliver Thick for this generated feature.
Minimum: Thin splinter fragments.
Maximum: Thicker splinter fragments.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_lift:
How far the tip of a sliver curls up out of the surface.
0: slivers lie flat.
High: slivers stick up and curl.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_sliver_embed:
How far the root of a sliver runs into the intact wood, in cm.
Low: slivers start right at the tear.
High: slivers peel from far inside the board.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_enable:
Turns broken plaster with wooden laths behind it on for this object.
Off: no lath damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: holes with laths and studs behind them are added.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_seed:
Changes where the patches go and their shapes. The images use Amount 3.
Every number gives another arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_mode:
Choose Mode. Automatic; Paint.
Automatic: select this mode variant.
Paint: select this mode variant.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_avoid:
Keeps lath damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: holes may land on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_detail:
Octaves of the noise (1 to 8, default 4). The change is small.
Low (1): soft lumps only.
High (8): a little more fine grain.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_amount:
Share of the rows that carry a lath at all (default 1).
Low (0.3): only a few rows have a strip.
High (1): every row has a strip.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_size_min:
Smallest size of a hole in the plaster, in cm.
Low: some holes are tiny.
High: even the smallest hole is big.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_size_max:
Largest size of a hole in the plaster, in cm.
Low: all holes stay small.
High: some holes grow large.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lobes:
Overlapping blobs per patch outline (default 4).
Low (1): a single rounded patch.
High (8): a large, cloud-like patch.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_stretch:
Largest elongation of a patch (default 1.8; 1 is about round).
Low (1): a compact patch.
High (4): a long strip of fallen plaster.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_edge_bias:
Pull of the patches toward sharp edges and corners (default 0.1). The images use Amount 4.
Low (0): patches anywhere on the face.
High (1): the patches sit on the edges of the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_paint_radius:
How wide the damage is along a line you drew, in cm.
Low: a thin broken strip.
High: a wide broken band.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_paint_snap:
How far from the surface a drawn line may be and still count, in cm.
Low: only lines drawn right on the wall are used.
High: lines floating far off the wall are used too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_paint_close:
How big a gap between the two ends of a drawn line is closed automatically, compared with the line length.
0: only lines you closed yourself become holes.
High: almost any curved line is closed into a hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_plaster_min:
Minimum depth of the plaster in front of the wood, in centimeters.
Low values allow the wood to sit nearer the wall surface. Raise this to increase the shallowest depth. Keep it at or below Plaster Max.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_plaster_max:
Upper depth of the front of the wooden layer below the wall surface, in centimeters.
A value equal to Plaster Min gives a fixed depth. A higher value allows deeper patches and more variation.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_jagged:
How ragged the outline is (default 0.6).
Low (0): smooth, rounded outline.
High (2): torn outline with loose islands of plaster.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_outline_scale:
Feature size of the outline noise (default 1).
Low (0.3): many small bites.
High (3): broad, smooth bulges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crumble:
Fine, crumbly bite along the plaster rim (default 0.6).
Low (0): a clean edge.
High (2): a crumbled edge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crumble_size:
Feature size of the crumble in cm (default 1.5; it is kept at least 2 grid cells). The images use Crumble 1.5.
Low (0.5 cm): fine grit on the edge.
High (5 cm): large chunks bitten out of the rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_terraces:
Stepped plaster coats (1 to 4, default 2).
Low (1): one step from the surface to the laths.
High (4): several coats; the deepest breaks back so far that only two small areas of laths show.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_terrace_skin:
Share of the plaster depth taken by the outer coat (default 0.35). The images use Terraces 3.
Low (0.1): a thin finish coat.
High (0.8): a thick outer step round the patch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_terrace_inset:
How far inside the patch each deeper coat breaks back, times the patch size (default 0.12). The images use Terraces 3.
Low (0): all coats break at the rim.
High (0.4): the deeper coats shrink away; the laths are no longer reached.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_wall_soft:
Width of the sloping transition into the cut (default 0.05).
Low (0): sheer plaster walls.
High (0.5): softer, wider slopes round the patch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_roughness:
How strong each finer octave is compared with the one before (0 to 0.95, default 0.5).
Low (0.2): smooth lumps.
High (0.9): jagged, broken relief.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_thickness_cap:
Largest cut depth as a share of the local wall thickness, outside holes (default 0.7; 0 = off). The images use a 7 cm wall and Cavity Depth 6 cm.
Low (0.2): the cut stops in the plaster; no laths show.
High (0, off): the cavity cuts through the thin wall in places.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_surf_mode:
Procedural (default): a noise displacement; Strength starts at 0 (the surface as built), and Noise Scale, Detail, Distortion and Roughness appear when it is above 0 (Strength, Scale and Detail are described on the Brick Damage page). Texture: a grayscale image (empty = the bundled gravel displacement) displaced on the finished faces behind the knocked-out bricks, triplanar in object space; their rim stays put. Texture shows Height Texture, Texture Scale, Texture Depth and Offset X / Y / Z.
Procedural, Strength 0: a plain back.
Texture: a slightly gravelly back; at this distance the change is small.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_path:
A black and white image that roughens the broken surface. White sticks out, black sinks in.
Empty: the built-in gravel image is used.
Assigned: your own image shapes the break.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_scale:
Size of one texture tile (default 20 cm).
Low (5 cm): fine grain.
High (60 cm): broad relief. The back shows only in a few gaps here, so the change is small.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_strength:
Peak-to-peak displacement (default 1 cm; 0 = procedural only). Narrow gaps fade it out.
Low (0.3 cm): faint.
High (3 cm): deep relief.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_edge:
Triangle size on the back faces; 0 = Texture Scale / 30. The back of a brick patch is large: 0.8-1 cm keeps updates interactive.
Minimum: At zero use the automatic size described above; small positive sizes produce fine, heavier geometry.
Maximum: Larger cells or edges: coarser, faster geometry that may lose small features.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_offset_x:
X translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative X.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive X. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_offset_y:
Y translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Y.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Y. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_tex_offset_z:
Z translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Z.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Z. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_surf_mode:
Choose Back Surface. Procedural: As built; Texture: Image displacement on the area behind the laths, like the Concrete spall surface.
Procedural: As built.
Texture: Image displacement on the area behind the laths, like the Concrete spall surface.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_path:
A black and white image that roughens the broken plaster. White sticks out, black sinks in.
Empty: the built-in gravel image is used.
Assigned: your own image shapes the break.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_scale:
How big one repeat of the image is on the wall, in cm.
Low: small, busy texture detail.
High: large, stretched-out texture detail.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_strength:
How deep the image presses into the broken plaster, in cm.
0: the image is ignored, only the built-in bumps remain.
High: deep, rough relief from the image.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_edge:
0 uses Texture Scale / 60.
Minimum: At zero use the automatic size described above; small positive sizes produce fine, heavier geometry.
Maximum: Larger cells or edges: coarser, faster geometry that may lose small features.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_offset_x:
X translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative X.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive X. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_offset_y:
Y translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Y.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Y. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_tex_offset_z:
Z translation of the procedural pattern in local coordinates.
Minimum: Move the pattern toward negative Z.
Maximum: Move the pattern toward positive Z. Feature size is unchanged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_cavity_depth:
How deep the dark gaps go behind the back of the laths, in cm (default 3).
Low (0.5 cm): a shallow, light floor right behind the laths.
High (8 cm): deep, dark gaps.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_keys:
Share of the gaps still filled with plaster keys (0 to 1, default 0.35).
Low (0): open gaps between all laths.
High (1): the gaps are filled; plaster lies over parts of the laths.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_key_size:
Feature size of the plaster keys, in cm (default 2.5). The images use Keys 0.6.
Low (1 cm): small blobs between the strips.
High (8 cm): large lumps of plaster.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_hole_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit hole enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use hole enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_hole_chance:
Share of the patches (or strokes) that break through (default 0.6). The images use Amount 4.
Low (0): no holes.
High (1): every patch has a hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_hole_size:
Share of the patch interior that is open (default 0.45).
Low (0.2): a small opening.
High (0.9): most of the patch is open; the laths that stay bridge it.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_hole_jagged:
Amplitude of the hole outline noise (default 0.6). The images use Hole Size 0.7.
Low (0): a smooth opening.
High (2): a torn opening.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_hole_laths:
Share of the laths that still bridge a hole; the rest snap at its rim (default 0.15). The images use Hole Size 0.7.
Low (0): the hole is clear of laths.
High (0.8): nearly every lath runs across the hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit crack enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use crack enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_amount:
Cracks per patch (default 3).
Low (0): no cracks.
High (10): many cracks.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_length_min:
Shortest crack running out of a hole, in cm.
Low: some cracks are very short.
High: even the shortest crack is long.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_length_max:
Longest crack running out of a hole, in cm.
Low: all cracks stay short.
High: some cracks run far across the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_width:
Opening at the surface, in cm (default 0.3).
Low (0.1 cm): fine lines.
High (1 cm): open cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_depth:
Depth of the grooves, in cm (default 0.8).
Low (0.2 cm): shallow.
High (2.5 cm): deep, dark grooves.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_meander:
Side-to-side wandering (default 0.45).
Low (0): straight cracks.
High (1.5): kinked cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_branch:
Chance of one fork per crack (default 0.35).
Low (0): single lines.
High (1): forked cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_crack_interior:
Share of cracks that start inside the patch (default 0). Inside, they fall on the laths and hardly show. The images use Crack Amount 8.
Low (0): all cracks start at the rim.
High (1): fewer cracks reach the plaster outside.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit lath enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use lath enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_amount:
Share of the rows that carry a lath at all (default 1).
Low (0.3): only a few rows have a strip.
High (1): every row has a strip.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_width:
Width of each strip in cm, measured along Up (default 3.5).
Low (2 cm): many narrow strips.
High (6 cm): fewer, wide boards.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_thickness:
Thickness of the strips into the wall, in cm (default 0.8). The images look from the side.
Low (0.4 cm): thin slats.
High (2 cm): thick battens.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_gap:
Gap between neighbouring strips in cm (default 0.9; spacing = width + gap).
Low (0.3 cm): strips almost touching.
High (2.5 cm): wide gaps.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_scale:
Multiplies width, thickness, gap, length and embed (default 1).
Low (0.5): fine slats.
High (2): coarse boards.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_angle:
Rotation of the rows about the surface normal, in degrees (default 0). The patch frame turns with it, so the outline changes too.
Low (0°): horizontal rows.
High (45°): diagonal rows.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_length:
Length of one strip in cm; butt joints are staggered (default 120; 0 = endless).
Low (30 cm): many joints.
High (0, endless): no joints.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_embed:
How far the laths continue under the intact plaster, in cm (default 6). The images use Lath Broken 0.
Low (0): in our test no laths were built at all: strips with no length under the plaster have nothing holding them.
High (20 cm): long strips under the plaster (hidden from the front).
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_jitter:
Per-strip variation of offset, width and thickness (0 to 1, default 0.4).
Low (0): perfectly regular strips.
High (1): uneven widths and gaps.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_tilt:
Largest slope of a strip off the row direction, in degrees (default 0.6).
Low (0°): all strips parallel.
High (3°): strips visibly askew.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_warp:
Waviness of a strip in and out of the wall, times its thickness (default 0.25). The images look from the side.
Low (0): flat strips.
High (1): strips bowing in and out.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_edge:
Ragged, uneven strip edges (default 0.4; 0 = sawn straight).
Low (0): straight edges.
High (1.5): worn, wavy edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_missing:
Chance that a strip is missing in a patch, never two in a row (default 0.06).
Low (0): every strip is there.
High (0.4): many single strips gone.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_broken:
Chance that an exposed strip away from holes is snapped (default 0.15).
Low (0): unbroken strips.
High (0.6): many snapped strips with gaps.
