Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_bend:
How far snapped ends are pushed in or out, times the thickness (default 1.2). The images use Lath Broken 0.5 and look from the side.
Low (0): the broken ends stay in line.
High (4): the ends stick out of the wall plane.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_lath_splinter:
Splinter length at snapped ends, times the strip width (default 1.2). The images use Lath Broken 0.5.
Low (0): square, clean breaks.
High (4): long, pointed splinters.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_up_x:
object-space "up"; laths run across it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative X.
Maximum: Point toward positive X. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_up_y:
object-space "up"; laths run across it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Y.
Maximum: Point toward positive Y. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_up_z:
object-space "up"; laths run across it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Z.
Maximum: Point toward positive Z. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_enable:
Turns Wallpaper on: paper strips with thickness on the walls, with open seams, torn strips with hanging flaps and lifted edges
Off: no wallpaper
On: walls are papered and damaged
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seed:
Changes which strips are torn and how, without changing the sizes.
Every number gives a different arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_thickness:
Thickness of the paper, in cm.
Low: thin paper, the tears are barely a step.
High: thick paper with a clear step at every edge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_strip_width:
Width of one wallpaper strip, in cm. A standard roll is 53 cm.
Low: many narrow strips.
High: few wide strips; tears get wider too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_offset:
Slides every seam sideways, in cm (0 to Strip Width).
Low (0): seams start at the default position.
High: all seams shift; use it to move a seam away from a corner or a door.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_dir_x:
X component of the "up" direction along the strips, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1), vertical strips
0: no part of the direction along X
1: the direction points along X (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_dir_y:
Y component of the "up" direction along the strips, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1), vertical strips
0: no part of the direction along Y
1: the direction points along Y (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_dir_z:
Z component of the "up" direction along the strips, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1), vertical strips
0: no part of the direction along Z
1: the direction points along Z (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_wall_angle:
A face is papered when its normal is within this angle of horizontal, in degrees.
Low: only exactly vertical walls get paper.
High: sloped faces (attic walls) get paper too. The test wall has only vertical faces.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_detail:
Polygon density of the paper, tear edges and flaps.
Low: coarse tear edges and faceted flaps, fast updates.
High: finely torn edges and smooth curls, heavy mesh.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_avoid:
Keeps wallpaper damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: wallpaper may peel on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seams_enabl:
Cuts the joints between the strips
Off: the paper is one continuous sheet
On: a visible joint between every two strips
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_width:
Width of the gap at a seam, in cm.
Low: tight, barely visible joints. The seam images are a close-up of one seam.
High: wide gaps between strips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_depth:
Depth of the seam gap, x Thickness (1 = down to the wall).
Low: a shallow line in the paper.
High: a gap down to the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_open:
Stretches of the seam where it gapes wider.
Low (0): an even seam.
High (1): seams gape open along many stretches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tears_enabl:
Tears paper off the strips
Off: intact paper
on: torn strips with flaps
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_amount:
Number of torn strips, one per strip, never two side by side. The test wall is papered on both sides, so some tears land on the back.
Low: a single tear.
High: many torn strips (fewer if the wall runs out of strips).
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_length:
Shortest torn area along the strip, in cm. Keep it at or below Tear Length Max
low: short tears near the top are possible
High: every tear runs far down
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Longest torn area along the strip, in cm. Keep it at or above Tear Length Min
Low: only short tears
High: tears running far down the wall are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_width_:
Narrowest tear, as a share of the strip width. Keep it at or below Tear Width Max
Low: narrow tears inside the strip are possible
High: every tear is wide
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Widest tear, as a share of the strip width (1 = seam to seam). Keep it at or above Tear Width Min
low: only narrow tears
1: the full strip width can be torn
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_diagon:
Shape of the tear front.
Low (0): a level tear front across the strip.
High (1): the front runs diagonally down from the top corner.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_from_t:
Chance that a tear starts at the top edge of the wall.
Low (0): tears start anywhere on the strip.
High (1): every tear starts at the top edge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_side:
Which seam the long side of the tear follows: 0 random, 1 left seam, 2 right seam.
0: a random side for each tear.
1 or 2: all tears hang on the same side.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_tear_jagged:
Raggedness of the torn edges.
Low (0): smooth torn edges.
High: ragged, frayed edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_crack:
Chance of a split running on down the seam below a tear.
Low (0): the seam is intact below the tear.
High (1): the seam splits below every tear.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_crack_:
Length of that split, x tear length (images use Seam Crack 1).
Low: a short split.
High: a split running far down the wall. Seam Crack and its Length showed no visible change on the test wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flaps_enabl:
Keeps the torn paper as a hanging flap
Off: the torn paper is removed, only the bare patch remains
On: the paper hangs from the tear front
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_amount:
Share of the torn paper still hanging on.
Low: a short stub of paper.
High: almost all torn paper hangs down.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_fold:
How far the flap folds over at the tear front, in degrees (180 = flat on the wall).
Low: the flap sticks out from the wall.
High (180°): the flap lies folded flat against the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_fold_r:
Radius of the fold crease, x tear size.
Low: a sharp crease.
High: a soft, rounded fold.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_curl:
How far the hanging paper turns outward toward its free end, in degrees (0 to 300).
Low (0): a flat flap.
High: the end rolls up into a curl.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_curl_f:
Where the curl happens.
Low (1): one even arc over the whole flap.
High: a straight hang with a tight roll at the end.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_cone:
How much the roll gathers where the flap reaches farthest, giving a cone-shaped roll.
Low (0): a cylindrical roll.
High (1): a strongly conical roll.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_wave:
Soft waviness of the paper.
Low (0): smooth, stiff paper.
High (1): wavy, soft paper.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_ragged:
Raggedness of the torn end of the flap.
Low (0): a clean flap end.
High: a ragged, torn flap end.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_group:
Write the hanging flaps to the vertex group 'PD_Wallpaper Flaps': 0 where the paper is on or near the wall, rising smoothly to 1 at the free end. Use it as the affected zone of a wind setup in Geometry Nodes.
Off: omit flap wind group while keeping its stored settings.
On: use flap wind group with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_wall_f:
How quickly a hanging flap becomes free to move as it leaves the wall. Used for the cloth weights.
Low: the flap is free almost right at the wall.
High (1): only the far tip of the flap is fully free.
Allowed range: 0.01 to 1.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_height:
How much lower-hanging paper is made freer than paper near its attachment.
0: only the distance from the wall counts.
1: paper hanging far below its attachment moves the most.
Allowed range: 0 to 1.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_flap_smooth:
Softens the weights of the flaps so they bend without kinks.
0: sharp borders between stiff and free paper.
High (50): very soft, gradual bending.
Allowed range: 0 to 50.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_lifts_enabl:
Lifts small edges of paper along free seams
Off: all seams lie flat
On: some seam edges peel and curl
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_lift_amount:
Number of lifted edges (fewer if there is no free seam).
Low (0): no lifts.
High: many peeling seams.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_lift_length:
Shortest lifted edge along the seam, in cm. Keep it at or below Lift Length Max
Low: short peeled spots are possible
High: every lift is long
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Longest lifted edge along the seam, in cm. Keep it at or above Lift Length Min
low: only short peeled spots
High: long peeled stretches are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_lift_width_:
Narrowest lift, how far the paper is peeled off from the seam, in cm. Keep it at or below Lift Width Max
Low: a narrow lifted edge is possible
High: every lift is a wide band
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Widest lift, how far the paper is peeled off from the seam, in cm. Keep it at or above Lift Width Min
Low: only narrow lifted edges
high: wide peeled bands are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_lift_curl:
How far a lifted edge curls, in degrees.
Low: the edge just stands off the wall.
High: the edge rolls up.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_paint_enabl:
Automatically enabled while a wallpaper drawing is assigned.
Off: omit paint enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use paint enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_paint_reach:
How far a stroke can be from the wall and still be projected onto it.
Low: only strokes drawn right on the wall are used.
High: strokes away from the wall are used too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_paint_jagge:
Extra raggedness of the drawn tear outline.
Low (0): the tear follows your outline exactly.
High: a ragged, torn edge around your outline.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_seam_snap:
Distance within which a drawn edge snaps to the nearest seam.
Low: the tear edge stays where you drew it.
High: edges near a seam jump onto it, like paper that tears off along the seam.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.wood_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that shows where the wood is torn. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: tears are placed automatically.
Assigned: tears follow your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.lath_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that shows where the plaster breaks off. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: holes are placed automatically.
Assigned: holes follow your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.wallpaper_drawing:
Grease Pencil or curve object with the strokes that outline areas where the paper is torn away. Without a drawing the tears are placed automatically. New Drawing creates one, Draw / Edit lets you draw on the object
empty or no drawing: nothing is made from strokes
More strokes: more places get the effect
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_holes_drawing:
Grease Pencil or curve object with the strokes that become holes (Draw placement). New Drawing creates one, Draw / Edit lets you draw on the object
empty or no drawing: nothing is made from strokes
More strokes: more places get the effect
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edges_drawing:
Grease Pencil or curve object with the strokes that become torn edge slits (Draw placement). Start the strokes at the cloth border. New Drawing creates one, Draw / Edit lets you draw on the object
empty or no drawing: nothing is made from strokes
More strokes: more places get the effect
ProjectDamageProps.hit_collection:
Collection with the impact empties. Each empty is one hit, its sphere radius is the radius of the damage zone. Add Hit creates the collection and an empty at the 3D cursor
Empty collection: no impacts
More empties: more hits, scale each empty to set its size
ProjectDamageProps.all_off:
Mute every damage module at once, keeping all settings.
Off: omit all effects off while keeping its stored settings.
On: use all effects off with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.global_scale:
Multiply the physical dimensions of the damage effects together. Counts and source-object dimensions do not scale.
Minimum: smallest supported damage features.
Maximum: largest supported features; large cuts may be limited by local wall thickness.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.global_detail:
Multiply the sampling quality used by damage effects. Placement and random seeds stay fixed.
Minimum: coarse, faster geometry that can lose small features.
Maximum: finer, more expensive geometry; individual budgets may limit refinement.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.ui_boolean_enable:
Enable Boolean cutters and nested Rebar for this source. Disabling keeps links and settings but suppresses their output.
Off: omit boolean break while keeping its stored settings.
On: use boolean break with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.seed:
Select a repeatable random arrangement shared by the damage effects.
Minimum: one deterministic pattern.
Maximum: a different deterministic pattern, not more damage.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.topology:
How the result mesh is assembled from the Boolean output.
Triangles: Raw Boolean triangles.
Quads: Coplanar triangles merged back into quads.
N-gons: Quads plus an N-gon overlay per merged region.
Keep: Restore the input topology on untouched polygons.
ProjectDamageProps.damage_shading:
Preserve the source surface normals and smooth damaged surfaces without smoothing across damage rims.
Off: omit damage shading v2 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use damage shading v2 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.damage_smooth_angle:
Maximum angle in degrees between damage faces that can share a smooth normal; higher values soften damage.
Minimum: Keep more folds sharp; only nearly coplanar faces share smooth normals.
Maximum: Allow smoothing across larger folds; feature boundaries remain protected.
Allowed range: 0 to 180.
ProjectDamageProps.base_smooth_angle:
Damage faces that meet the untouched surface at less than this angle blend into it smoothly; steeper rims stay crisp, 0 keeps every rim crisp. The untouched surface always keeps its source shading.
Minimum: Keep more folds sharp; only nearly coplanar faces share smooth normals.
Maximum: Allow smoothing across larger folds; feature boundaries remain protected.
Allowed range: 0 to 180.
If shading artifacts appear, set Base Smooth Angle to 0.
ProjectDamageProps.preserve_data:
Copy all UV maps, source materials, supported public attributes and groups to the generated result.
Off: omit preserve source data while keeping its stored settings.
On: use preserve source data with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.keep_uvs:
Carry the active UV layer through the cut; damage faces get a bounding-box cube projection. Off is faster and byte-identical to a mesh with no UVs at all.
Off: omit keep uvs while keeping its stored settings.
On: use keep uvs with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.keep_selections:
Carry the source mesh's material assignment through: undamaged faces keep their own material slot, damage classes take the slots after them. Off is faster and byte-identical to a mesh with one material.
Off: omit keep selections while keeping its stored settings.
On: use keep selections with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.quad_remesh:
Rebuild the whole damaged main result as four-sided faces or triangles on its existing surface. Includes Smart Remesh; may increase face count 10 to 20 times. Separate generated objects are not remeshed.
Off: omit quad remesh while keeping its stored settings.
On: use quad remesh with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.quad_remesh_output:
Final output faces after remeshing; untouched source n-gons are not restored when Quad Remesh succeeds.
Quads: Four-sided output faces.
Triangles: Split each quad along its shorter diagonal.
ProjectDamageProps.quad_remesh_size:
Size of the square faces on flat untouched areas, compared with the fine faces at the damage.
Low: many small faces, heavy and slow.
High: few large faces, light mesh.
Allowed range: 0.5 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.smart_remesh:
Improve long thin triangles around cuts and damaged rims, keeping untouched faces, material zones and UV seams; adds rebuild time.
Off: omit smart remesh while keeping its stored settings.
On: use smart remesh with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.smart_remesh_density:
How fine the triangles are right at the damage.
Low: coarse triangles, fast.
High: fine triangles, sharper damage but heavier and slower.
Allowed range: 0.25 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.smart_remesh_grade:
How quickly the triangles grow as they get farther from the damage.
Low: a long, dense transition.
High: triangles get big right next to the damage.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_attr:
Name of the face marking that protects part of the object from damage.
Empty: nothing is protected.
Assigned: damage that would land on marked faces goes elsewhere.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_chips:
Edge chips honour the Avoid Selection.
Off: omit chips while keeping its stored settings.
On: use chips with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_surf:
Surface craters honour the Avoid Selection.
Off: omit surface while keeping its stored settings.
On: use surface with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_build:
Buildup honours the Avoid Selection.
Off: omit buildup while keeping its stored settings.
On: use buildup with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_fract:
Fracture honours the Avoid Selection.
Off: omit fracture while keeping its stored settings.
On: use fracture with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.avoid_corner:
Corner damage honours the Avoid Selection.
Off: omit corners while keeping its stored settings.
On: use corners with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.mask_group:
Vertex group weighting where damage lands (1.0 = full damage, 0.0 = none). Linking one never MOVES an element, only removes or shrinks it.
Empty: no vertex-group restriction.
Assigned: use the named group weights on this object.
ProjectDamageProps.mask_amount:
How much of the damage is kept where the selection mask applies.
0%: almost nothing is kept.
100%: all the damage is kept.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.mask_size:
How much the selection mask also shrinks the damage.
0%: the mask changes only how much damage there is.
100%: the damage gets smaller where the mask is weak.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_enable:
Limit damage with Grease Pencil or Curve strokes; combines with the vertex-group mask.
Off: omit draw mask while keeping its stored settings.
On: use draw mask with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that marks where damage is allowed. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: no drawn mask is used.
Assigned: damage appears only around your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_mode:
Choose Mode. Paint Damage: Damage starts only near the drawing; Erase Damage: Keep the drawn area clean; damage starts elsewhere.
Paint Damage: Damage starts only near the drawing.
Erase Damage: Keep the drawn area clean; damage starts elsewhere.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_radius:
How far from your strokes the damage may appear, in cm.
Low: damage hugs the strokes.
High: damage spreads far from the strokes.
Allowed range: 0.001 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_soft:
How softly the damage thins out toward the border of the drawn zone.
0%: a hard border, full damage right up to it.
100%: damage thins out gradually from the stroke.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.draw_mask_size:
Makes the damage smaller toward the border of the drawn zone.
0%: only the amount changes, sizes stay.
100%: pieces shrink strongly near the border.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.edge_threshold:
Minimum angle between adjacent source faces for their edge to count as sharp.
Minimum: more gently bent edges qualify.
Maximum: only the sharpest folds qualify; above a cube corner angle, its edges are excluded.
Allowed range: 0 degrees to 180 degrees.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_x:
Choose X. On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips; Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips.
Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_y:
Choose Y. On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips; Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips.
Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_z:
Choose Z. On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips; Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
On: Chains dominant on this axis are eligible for chips.
Off: Chains dominant on this axis are skipped.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_x_toggle:
Enable edge damage along the local X axis.
Off: omit x while keeping its stored settings.
On: use x with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_y_toggle:
Enable edge damage along the local Y axis.
Off: omit y while keeping its stored settings.
On: use y with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.axis_z_toggle:
Enable edge damage along the local Z axis.
Off: omit z while keeping its stored settings.
On: use z with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.live_update:
Rebuild automatically as settings or a linked breaker change.
Off: omit live update while keeping its stored settings.
On: use live update with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.defer_ms:
Wait this many milliseconds after an edit before rebuilding in Live Update.
Minimum: respond immediately, with more frequent rebuilds.
Maximum: wait longer so several edits can be combined into one rebuild.
Allowed range: 0 to 2000.
ProjectDamageProps.chips_enable:
Enables subtraction of edge chips.
Off: Disabled: no edge cutters.
On: Enabled: eligible convex edges receive chips.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_scale:
Multiplies chip size and depth together, then combines with Master Scale. It does not multiply Amount.
Minimum: 10% makes small, shallow chips.
Maximum: 400% makes the size and depth ranges four times their base dimensions, before Master Scale.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.detail:
Controls cutter tessellation, not the number of chip locations.
Minimum: 25% resolves fewer facets in each cutter.
Maximum: 800% resolves finer outlines and floors at greater Boolean cost.
Allowed range: 25% to 800%.
ProjectDamageProps.amount:
Requested chip density distributed among chains in proportion to their lengths, rounded separately per chain. It is not an exact count of visible holes because cutters can overlap or be rejected.
Minimum: Zero removes the primary chips.
Maximum: Larger counts pack more cutters along the same edge length; many can merge.
Allowed range: 0 to 50000.
ProjectDamageProps.size_min:
Lower bound of the primary cutter footprint. The size draw is biased toward smaller values; it is correlated with depth.
Minimum: Near zero admits tiny chips, some rejected as too small.
Maximum: Raising it makes even the smallest chips larger; keep it no greater than Size Max.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.size_max:
Upper bound of primary cutter size before Scale and Stretch.
Minimum: A small maximum keeps all chips small.
Maximum: A larger maximum permits broad missing chunks; it does not force every chip to be large.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.depth_min:
Lower bound of cut depth before Scale. The draw partly follows the sampled size.
Minimum: Near zero permits shallow scuffs.
Maximum: A higher minimum makes every accepted cut deeper.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.depth_max:
Upper depth bound, subject to local thickness protection when enabled.
Minimum: A small maximum keeps cuts shallow.
Maximum: A larger maximum permits deep cuts and, without a guard, possible breakthrough.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.stretch:
Stretches chips along the edge direction only, without changing their depth
Low (25%): short, round chips
High (400%): long chips running along the edge, like a worn strip
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.rim_soft:
Rounds the border of each chip into a smooth fillet
0%: sharp, vertical chip walls, a fresh hard break
100%: soft rounded rims, an old worn and smoothed look
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.normalize:
Limits chip size and depth by the local thickness of the object, so thin parts are not destroyed
Off: chips use their full size everywhere, thin parts can be cut through
On: chips shrink on thin parts, the limit is set by Max Size vs Thickness
ProjectDamageProps.norm_max_size:
Maximum chip size and depth as a share of the local thickness. Works only when Limit by Thickness is on
low (5%): chips on thin parts become very small
High (100%): chips can be as large as the part is thick
Allowed range: 5% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.offset:
Slides all chips alng their edge by the same amount, without chaging their spacing. Use it to move chips away from an unlucky spot
0%: chips stay at their original positions
100%: chips are shifted a full step along each edge, back to a similar layout
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.random_offset:
how much each chip moves away from even spacing along the edge
0%: chips are spaced perfectly evenly, looks artificial
100%: chips are placed fully randomly along the edge, natural look
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.noise_strength:
pushes the surface inside chips in and out with noise, in cm, to make them look rough
0: smooth chip surfaces, noise is off
high: strongly bumpy, rough chip surfaces
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.noise_scale:
Size of the bumps made by Noise Strength, in cm
Low: small, fine grain-like bumps
High: large, soft waves across the chip
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.sec_amount:
Number of small extra chips placed around the rim of each main chip
0: off, main chips have clean rims
High: every chip has a frayed rim with many small chips around it
Allowed range: 0 to 50000.
ProjectDamageProps.sec_size:
Size of the rim chips as a share of the main chip size
Low (1%): tiny rim chips, barely visible
High (100%): rim chips as big as the main chip
Allowed range: 1% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.sec_depth:
Depth of the rim chips as a share of the main chip depth
Low (1%): rim chips are just surface marks
high (100%): rim chips cut as deep as the main chip
Allowed range: 1% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_cluster:
Warps positions using the inverse cumulative distribution of low-frequency noise along each edge. It concentrates wear into stretches without directly changing Amount.
Minimum: 0% keeps the unwarped distribution.
Maximum: 100% creates the strongest worn and relatively intact stretches.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_fine:
Adds a separate population of smaller chips with its own random stream; the main population is not rerolled by this control.
Minimum: 0% adds no fine chips.
Maximum: 200% permits the densest secondary fine-chip population.
Allowed range: 0% to 200%.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_profile:
Changes the internal broken-floor profile and increases the depth factor, rather than adding a new population.
Minimum: 0% uses the basic bowl profile.
Maximum: 100% adds stronger irregular internal relief and up to a 1.3 depth factor before other modifiers.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_asym:
Increases random cutter tilt and a depth multiplier. It makes one side of a chip steeper than another.
Minimum: 0% uses the base tilt and depth factor.
Maximum: 100% allows stronger tilts and up to a 1.6 depth factor, combined with Profile.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.chip_guard:
A positive value caps depth to this fraction of measured local thickness and limits width. Zero is a special disabled state.
Minimum: 0% disables the guard, rather than giving maximum protection.
Maximum: 100% permits up to the full measured thickness; small positive percentages impose stricter caps.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_mode:
chooses where the cracks come from
Procedural: the generator places all cracks over the whole object by itself
Paint: you draw the Level 1 cracks, Levels 2 and 3 branch from your strokes. Proximity: cracks only around the points you place
ProjectDamageProps.fract_asset:
Choose Fracture Asset. Fracture: Legacy shared fracture; Fracture Concrete: Original concrete crack network; Fracture Wood: Grain-directed crack network; Fracture Glass: Glass spokes and ring chords; Fracture Radial: Radial stars; Fracture Proximity Default: Cracks only at linked proximity points; Radial Fracture Proximity: Radial cracks at linked points; Glass Fracture Proximity: Glass cracks at linked points; Fracture Through: Shared through fracture; Fracture Volume: Crack-driven surface pieces and rough interior cells.
Fracture: Legacy shared fracture.
Fracture Concrete: Original concrete crack network.
Fracture Wood: Grain-directed crack network.
Fracture Glass: Glass spokes and ring chords.
Fracture Radial: Radial stars.
Fracture Proximity Default: Cracks only at linked proximity points.
Radial Fracture Proximity: Radial cracks at linked points.
Glass Fracture Proximity: Glass cracks at linked points.
Fracture Through: Shared through fracture.
Fracture Volume: Crack-driven surface pieces and rough interior cells.
ProjectDamageProps.chips_mode:
Automatic considers suitable edge chains; Draw admits only candidate points within the drawing radius.
Low / first state: Automatic covers all eligible chains.
High / other state: Draw limits candidates to the linked strokes; no valid strokes means no drawn chips.
ProjectDamageProps.chips_drawing:
Linked Grease Pencil or supported curve paths, read at the current frame and transformed into source-local space. Use New Drawing to create an input, Draw / Edit to paint, and the trash button to remove it.
Low / first state: Empty supplies no drawing constraint or no drawn damage, according to the placement mode.
High / other state: Assigned visible strokes guide placement; geometry outside their eligible region is not made eligible merely by drawing there.
ProjectDamageProps.chips_paint_radius:
Maximum source-local distance from an edge candidate to a drawn stroke, expressed in centimetres by the addon.
Minimum: A small radius requires the stroke to closely follow the edge.
Maximum: A large radius admits nearby chains too; it does not increase chip size.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_mode:
Procedural samples triangles by area. Paint projects closed regions and accepts cutters only inside them.
Low / first state: Procedural scatters over eligible source faces.
High / other state: Paint requires a valid contour; radii shrink near its boundary and depth is capped against local wall thickness.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_drawing:
Linked Grease Pencil or supported curve paths, read at the current frame and transformed into source-local space. Use New Drawing to create an input, Draw / Edit to paint, and the trash button to remove it.
Low / first state: Empty supplies no drawing constraint or no drawn damage, according to the placement mode.
High / other state: Assigned visible strokes guide placement; geometry outside their eligible region is not made eligible merely by drawing there.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_close_strokes:
Treats a drawn contour as closed for the surface mask.
Off: Off requires an already closed contour.
On: On closes a contour for area-based placement; open scribbles should not be used as precise area outlines.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_paint_snap:
Maximum projection distance used to associate drawing paths with the source surface.
Minimum: A small distance rejects strokes that float away from the surface.
Maximum: A large distance accepts more distant paths and can select the wrong nearby surface.
Allowed range: 0.001 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l1_paint_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit paint level 1 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use paint level 1 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l1_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that gives the path of the main cracks. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: main cracks are placed automatically.
Assigned: main cracks follow your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l1_paint_radius:
The widest a painted crack can be, measured from the stroke to each side, in cm. It limits how far the groove may spread from your stroke.
Low: the crack stays thin and follows the stroke tightly. High: the crack is allowed to open up wide around the stroke.
Allowed range: 0.04 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l2_paint_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit paint level 2 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use paint level 2 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l2_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that gives the path of the second-level cracks. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: these cracks are placed automatically.
Assigned: these cracks follow your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l2_paint_radius:
The widest a painted crack can be, measured from the stroke to each side, in cm. It limits how far the groove may spread from your stroke.
Low: the crack stays thin and follows the stroke tightly. High: the crack is allowed to open up wide around the stroke.
Allowed range: 0.04 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l3_paint_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit paint level 3 while keeping its stored settings.
On: use paint level 3 with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l3_drawing:
A Grease Pencil drawing or curve that gives the path of the finest cracks. Draw close to the surface.
Empty: these cracks are placed automatically.
Assigned: these cracks follow your strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.fract_l3_paint_radius:
The widest a painted crack can be, measured from the stroke to each side, in cm. It limits how far the groove may spread from your stroke.
Low: the crack stays thin and follows the stroke tightly. High: the crack is allowed to open up wide around the stroke.
Allowed range: 0.04 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_enable:
Enables surface cutter placement.
Off: Off leaves the faces uncut.
On: On uses Amount and the placement mode.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_type:
Concrete creates organic bowls. Wood Knife projects the grain into the face plane and creates long planar knife-shaped cuts.
Low / first state: Concrete gives crater-like damage.
High / other state: Wood Knife gives directional elongated marks; grain controls become relevant.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_grain_x:
X component of the local grain direction. The vector is projected into each sampled face plane and normalised.
Minimum: Negative values reverse the X contribution.
Maximum: Positive values turn the cuts toward local positive X; magnitude alone is not a size control.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_grain_y:
Y component of the local grain direction, projected into the sampled face plane.
Minimum: Negative values reverse the Y contribution.
Maximum: Positive values turn cuts toward local positive Y; use the three components together.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_grain_z:
Z component of the local grain direction. A fallback tangent is used when the projected vector degenerates.
Minimum: Negative values reverse the Z contribution.
Maximum: Positive values favour local positive Z; a vector parallel to a face normal cannot define an in-plane grain by itself.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_knife_jitter:
Random rotation around the face normal, in a symmetric range around the projected grain.
Minimum: 0 degrees keeps cuts aligned to grain.
Maximum: 180 degrees allows any in-plane direction.
Allowed range: 0 to 180.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_knife_back:
Probability of reversing the asymmetric knife cut along the grain.
Minimum: 0% retains the original direction.
Maximum: 100% reverses every knife mark; this is not random angular jitter.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_scale:
Multiplies footprint and depth ranges together with Master Scale.
Minimum: 10% gives small, shallow cuts.
Maximum: 400% gives four times the base dimensions before Master Scale.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_detail:
Tessellation of the crater or knife cutter. The host also multiplies it by Master Quality.
Minimum: 25% is coarse and cheaper.
Maximum: 400% resolves more of the procedural outline; this does not increase Amount.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_amount:
Target count of accepted primary cutters. Paint mode makes a bounded number of placement attempts; edge clearance or a small contour can prevent reaching the target.
Minimum: Zero creates no primary craters.
Maximum: Larger values add more cuts, which can overlap into one region.
Allowed range: 0 to 50000.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_size_min:
Lower footprint bound. Size Bias can reshape the draw within this range.
Minimum: Near zero admits small marks.
Maximum: A larger minimum excludes small craters; keep it at or below Size Max.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_size_max:
Upper footprint bound. Candidates near a sharp source edge or paint border may be shrunk or skipped.
Minimum: A low maximum produces small craters.
Maximum: A high maximum permits broad craters but cannot override clearance checks.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_depth_min:
Lower cut-depth bound before Scale and the thickness limits.
Minimum: Near zero admits shallow bowls.
Maximum: A higher minimum makes accepted craters deeper.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_depth_max:
Upper depth bound; Depth Follows Size can correlate the sampled depth with footprint.
Minimum: A small value limits relief.
Maximum: A large value permits deep cuts; paint and thickness guard can still cap it.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_noise:
Strength of irregularity on the organic cutter outline. This changes the Boolean shape, not a shader texture.
Minimum: 0% gives the smoothest outline supported by the cutter.
Maximum: 300% gives strongly distorted crater boundaries and can require higher Detail.
Allowed range: 0% to 300%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_noise_in:
Strength of the organic bowl's internal relief, tapered at its boundary.
Minimum: 0% gives a relatively even floor.
Maximum: 300% gives stronger internal height variation.
Allowed range: 0% to 300%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_sec_amount:
Secondary cuts placed on primary damage rims. The native secondary pass is intentionally disabled in Paint mode.
Minimum: Zero adds no rim cutters.
Maximum: Larger values add more small cuts in Procedural mode; Paint still suppresses this pass.
Allowed range: 0 to 50000.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_sec_size:
Secondary footprint as a percentage of the primary size range.
Minimum: 1% gives tiny rim damage.
Maximum: 100% uses the primary footprint range.
Allowed range: 1% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_sec_depth:
Secondary depth as a percentage of the primary depth range.
Minimum: 1% gives shallow marks.
Maximum: 100% permits full primary-range depth.
Allowed range: 1% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_cluster:
For procedural placement, tries to place new craters near a previous crater and project them back onto the mesh.
Minimum: 0% keeps independent surface samples.
Maximum: 100% maximises clustered placement attempts; Paint uses its contour instead.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_size_bias:
Raises a uniform size draw to an exponent from 1 to 4. It favours small craters while preserving the size bounds.
Minimum: 0% uses an unbiased range draw.
Maximum: 100% strongly favours sizes near Size Min with occasional large cuts.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_depth_follow:
Blends independent random depth toward a size-dependent depth with residual variation.
Minimum: 0% samples depth independently of size.
Maximum: 100% makes larger footprints generally deeper, while keeping some depth variation.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.surf_guard:
Positive values cap procedural cut depth to a fraction of local wall thickness. Paint has a separate 45% wall-depth limit.
Minimum: 0% disables this procedural guard.
Maximum: 100% permits the full measured thickness; a smaller positive fraction protects more strongly.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_enable:
Turns Beads on: a raised bead along the inside (concave) edges of the object, like sealant, a weld seam or dried mortar. Outside edges never get a bead
Off: no beads
on: beads on the inside edges, set by the settings below
ProjectDamageProps.build_scale:
Multiplies Width and Height of the bead together, keeping its proportions.
Low (10%): a thin hairline bead.
High (400%): a thick, heavy bead.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_detail:
Polygon density along the bead. It changes how smooth the bead is and how fast it updates, not its size.
Low (25%): few polygons, a faceted bead, fast updates.
High (400%): a smooth bead with fine lumps, heavier mesh.
Allowed range: 25% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_coverage:
Share of all inside edges that carry a bead.
Low (0%): no bead at all. Small values: one or two edges.
High (100%): every inside edge of the object has a bead. The edges are picked by chance, so at low values the beads on the test object all landed on hidden edges; there is no image.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_width:
Width of the bead across the edge, in cm (multiplied by Scale).
Low: a thin line in the corner.
High: a wide bead that reaches far onto both faces.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.build_height:
How far the bead rises out of the corner, in cm (multiplied by Scale).
Low: a flat smear in the corner.
High: a tall, rounded bead. The Fillet shape takes its size from Width; Height has no visible effect on it.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.build_irreg:
How much the width and height swell and shrink along the edge.
Low (0%): an even bead with the same thickness along the whole edge.
High (300%): a strongly swelling bead, thick and thin parts alternate.
Allowed range: 0% to 300%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_corner_prob:
Chance that an inside corner gets a pile of dirt.
0%: no corner piles.
100%: every inside corner has a pile.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_corner_size:
Size of a corner pile, in cm.
0: no piles.
High: big heaps in the corners.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.build_blend:
How smoothly a pile flows into the surfaces it sits on.
0%: a hard lump with a sharp border.
High (200%): a soft drift that melts into the surface.
Allowed range: 0% to 200%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_shape:
Cross-section of the bead
Rounded: a narrow half-round bead lying in the corner
Fillet: fills the corner as a cove that runs out onto both faces
ProjectDamageProps.build_lumps:
Small lumps and dents on the surface of the bead.
Low (0%): a smooth bead surface.
High (100%): a lumpy, uneven surface, like hand-applied filler. On the test object the lumps were too small to see, even at Resolution 400%.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.build_mode:
Chooses which inside edges get a bead
Automatic: edges are picked at random by Edges Covered
Draw Zones: only inside edges near your strokes get a bead. An empty drawing gives no bead
ProjectDamageProps.build_drawing:
Grease Pencil or curve object with the strokes that mark which inside edges get a bead (Draw Zones only). Draw along the edges. New Drawing creates one, Draw / Edit lets you draw on the object
empty or no drawing: nothing is made from strokes
More strokes: more places get the effect
ProjectDamageProps.build_paint_radius:
How far from a stroke an inside edge is still picked up.
Low: only an edge right under the stroke is used; you must draw precisely.
High: edges near the stroke are covered too, the bead can run past the end of the stroke.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.pile_enable:
Turns piles of dirt and rubble on for this object.
Off: no piles are made, the settings are kept.
On: piles are added.
ProjectDamageProps.pile_scale:
Multiplies Pile Size, so it makes all piles bigger or smaller without changing their proportions (10 to 400%, default 100%).
Low (50%): small heaps tucked into the corners.
High (200%): big heaps that fill the corner. A pile wider than the walls are thick can push through to the outside of the wall; keep the piles smaller than the wall thickness.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.pile_detail:
Polygon density of the piles (1 to 400%, default 100%). It changes how smooth they are and how fast they update, not their size.
Low (10%): coarse, faceted heaps; at very low values a thin spike can stick out of the pile along an edge.
High (400%): smooth heaps with finer detail, heavier mesh.
Allowed range: 1% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.pile_height:
Height of a pile as a share of its size (10 to 200%, default 60%).
Low (20%): a flat smear in the corner.
High (150%): a tall, round mound that stands up out of the corner.
Allowed range: 10% to 200%.
ProjectDamageProps.pile_lumps:
Smaller heaps that spill out of the corner along the inside edges (0 to 100%, default 40%). Each one is about a third to two thirds of the main heap. At 100% a pile gets two to four of them, at 40% one or two.
Low (0%): a single heap.
High (100%): extra heaps beside the main one, so the pile looks spilled rather than placed. The spill heaps stay close to the main heap and merge into it when Blend Into Surface is high, so the image uses Blend Into Surface 0% to show them; at 40% the only spill heap is hidden behind the main one.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_enable:
Turns a settled layer of dust and dirt on for this object.
Off: no deposit is made, the settings are kept.
On: the deposit is added.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_scale:
Multiplies Radius Min, Radius Max, Half Height and Shelter Radius together (10 to 400%, default 100%).
Low (50%): small specks of dirt.
High (200%): large lumps; fewer of them fit on narrow faces, so some candidates are dropped.
Allowed range: 10% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_detail:
Polygon density of each lump (1 to 400%, default 100%). It changes how smooth the lumps are, not their size.
Low (25%): faceted lumps, light mesh.
High (400%): smooth lumps with more surface detail, heavier mesh.
Allowed range: 1% to 400%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_amount:
Number of candidate points scattered over the surface (0 to 2000, default 120). Gravity, Shelter and the fit test decide how many of them become deposits. At 0 the Shape and Placement sections are hidden.
Low (40): a few scattered lumps.
High (400): a dense layer of dirt; lumps start to touch and merge.
Allowed range: 0 to 2000.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_style:
The look of the deposits. Compact Dirt: compact, irregular lumps with a few small satellite crumbs. Powder: shallow, soft and wide patches without satellites. Mineral Crust: broad, flat, rough patches with ragged edges. Organic Growth: taller, irregular lobes with several satellites almost as tall as the main body.
Each type also has its own steepest slope it can stay on with full Gravity Influence: about 34 degrees for Powder, 48 for Compact Dirt, 66 for Organic Growth and 72 for Mineral Crust.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_size_min:
Smallest radius of a deposit, multiplied by Scale (default 3 cm). Each lump gets a random radius between Radius Min and Radius Max, with more small lumps than large ones.
Low (1 cm): many small crumbs between the larger lumps.
High (6 cm): all lumps are large and close to Radius Max.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_size_max:
Largest radius of a deposit, multiplied by Scale (default 7 cm). If it is set below Radius Min, Radius Min is used.
Low (3.5 cm): lumps of nearly the same size.
High (15 cm): a few big patches stand out among the small ones.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_height:
Base height of a deposit, multiplied by Scale (default 1 cm). Each lump varies by about 25% up or down, and larger lumps get a little taller.
Low (0.3 cm): flat stains lying on the surface.
High (3 cm): tall domes; with large values some lumps get spiky, uneven tops.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_gravity:
How strongly deposits keep to faces that point up (0 to 100%, default 80%). Steeper faces than the angle of the Type lose their deposits; on slopes the lumps stretch downhill and get thinner.
Low (0%): deposits everywhere, also on walls and on the outside of the tray.
High (100%): only flat, upward faces keep deposits: the floor and the tops of the walls.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_gravity_direc:
The downward direction in the object's own (local) coordinates (default 0, 0, -1). Shown only when Gravity Influence is above 0. Turn it for objects lying on their side, or for dirt blown against a wall. The image uses Gravity Influence 100%.
0, 0, -1: deposits on the floor.
0, 1, 0: down is +Y, so deposits collect on faces that look toward -Y: the inside of the back wall and the outside of the front wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_shelter:
How strongly deposits prefer sheltered spots (0 to 100%, default 0%). For each candidate the generator casts rays in a half sphere and counts how many hit other geometry within Shelter Radius. Sheltered deposits also grow up to 35% bigger.
Low (0%): shelter is ignored.
High (100%): only spots next to walls and in corners keep deposits; the open middle of the floor stays clean.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_shelter_radiu:
How far the shelter test looks for surrounding geometry, multiplied by Scale (default 15 cm). It matters only when Shelter Influence is above 0; the image uses Shelter Influence 100%.
Low (5 cm): only spots right at a wall count as sheltered; in the test tray almost nothing survives.
High (40 cm): walls further away also give shelter, so deposits spread toward the middle of the floor.
Allowed range: 0.1 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_embed:
How much of each deposit sits below the surface (5 to 90%, default 30%). A deeper root also lowers the part above the surface.
Low (5%): the lump sits on top of the surface and rises a little higher.
High (90%): the lump is sunk into the surface and stands lower; it looks grown on rather than dropped on. The change is small.
Allowed range: 5% to 90%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_layers:
Number of stacked bodies in each deposit (1 to 4, default 1). Each extra layer is a smaller lump (about 78% of the one below) placed on top and slightly offset.
Low (1): a single smooth lump.
High (4): built-up, terraced lumps, like dirt that collected in several passes.
Allowed range: 1 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_porosity:
Chance of small pits cut into the top of each deposit (0 to 100%, default 0%). Mineral Crust gets the most pits, Powder the fewest.
Low (0%): closed, smooth lumps.
High (100%): lumps pitted with small holes, like porous crust or dried mud.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.deposit_separate:
Create closed deposit geometry as an independently editable object.
Off: omit separate deposit object while keeping its stored settings.
On: use separate deposit object with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_seed:
Shuffles where the paint peels and how the patches look, without changing size or amount.
Every number gives a different random arrangement.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: -2.14748e+09 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_satellites:
Small extra flake-offs scattered around the big peeled patches. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0%: only the main patches.
100%: many small chips around every patch.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_stretch:
How stretched the peeled patches are in one direction. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0%: roundish patches.
100%: long, streaky patches.
Allowed range: 0% to 100%.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_dir_x:
Local-space X component of dir. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local X component.
Maximum: Raise the local X component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_dir_y:
Local-space Y component of dir. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local Y component.
Maximum: Raise the local Y component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_dir_z:
Local-space Z component of dir. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local Z component.
Maximum: Raise the local Z component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_edge_wrap:
How strongly peeling is drawn to the edges and corners of the object. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0%: edges peel no more than flat areas.
High (200%): edges and corners peel first.
Allowed range: 0% to 200%.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_facing_only:
Enable Facing Only for this object.
Off: omit facing only while keeping its stored settings.
On: use facing only with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_facing_x:
Local-space X component of facing. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local X component.
Maximum: Raise the local X component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_facing_y:
Local-space Y component of facing. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local Y component.
Maximum: Raise the local Y component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_facing_z:
Local-space Z component of facing. Set all three components together to define a nonzero direction.
Minimum: Lower the local Z component.
Maximum: Raise the local Z component.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_facing_angle:
Set Facing Angle (degrees) for this generated feature.
Minimum: Rotate or tilt toward the lower end of the permitted angle range.
Maximum: Rotate or tilt toward the upper end; angles are not a damage-strength multiplier.
Allowed range: 0 to 180.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_flake_size:
Size of one paint flake, in cm.
Low: fine, crumbly flakes.
High: big sheets of paint.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.coating_crack_length:
Length of the cracks in the paint, in cm.
Low: short hairline cracks.
High: long cracks across the paint.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_enable:
Turns Fabric Classic on: holes, slits and threads torn into a thin cloth sheet. A thick block does not become cloth by this
Off: the cloth stays intact
On: tears and threads with the settings below
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_solid_enable:
Turns Fabric Solidify on: the same tears for cloth with real thickness, like a sheet with a Solidify modifier. Switches Mesh Preparation to Use Modifiers
Off: no tears
on: tears cut through the full thickness with rounded rims
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_solid:
internal: set from the Fabric (Solidify) tile.
Off: omit solid while keeping its stored settings.
On: use solid with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_layer_depth:
For garments with two layers (front and back of a shirt). Decides whether a tear cuts only the layer it lies on or also the layer behind it.
Low (0): a tear cuts only its own layer; you see the inside of the garment through the hole.
High: layers closer than this distance are cut together, the hole goes through both sides.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_flat:
Treat the cloth as a surface: tears and torn edges are cut straight into its faces, no thickness, works on an open single-layer mesh (cloth before Solidify). Applied on its own, without the other effects. Off = the solid (Boolean) tears, where Thickness is the cut depth.
Off: omit flat while keeping its stored settings.
On: use flat with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_seed:
Changes the random placement of all tears without changing their size or number.
Every number gives a different arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thickness:
Depth of cloth tear cutters measured into the panel.
Minimum (0): cut straight through the contacted surface.
Maximum: deeper cutters; a panel thinner than the depth is pierced.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_cut_margin:
How far the tear cutter reaches past the cloth, so that it cuts cleanly through.
0: the cutter stops at the surface and may leave thin skins.
High: a safe cut through thick or wavy cloth.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_detail:
Polygon density of the torn rims and threads. It changes how fine the rim is and how fast the effect updates, not the size of the tears.
Low: coarse, blocky rims, fast updates.
High: fine rims and round threads, heavy mesh and slow updates.
Allowed range: 0.05 to 4.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_avoid:
Keeps cloth tears away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: tears may land on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay whole.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_holes_enable:
Turns Interior Tears on: holes inside the cloth
Off: no interior holes, the values are kept
On: holes set by the settings below
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_amount:
Number of holes on the whole cloth.
Low (0): no interior holes.
High: many holes.
Allowed range: 0 to 500.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_length_mi:
Shortest hole, measured along the tear, in cm. Keep it at or below Length Max
low: small holes are possible
High: every hole is a long rip
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_length_ma:
Longest hole, measured along the tear, in cm. Keep it at or above Length Min
Low: only short holes
High: long rips across the cloth are possible
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_width_min:
Narrowest hole, measured across the tear, in cm. Keep it at or below Width Max
Low: thin slits are possible
high: every hole is wide open
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_width_max:
Widest hole, measured across the tear, in cm. Keep it at or above Width Min
Low: only narrow slits
High: wide open holes are possible
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_jagged:
Raggedness of the hole outline.
Low (0): smooth lens shapes.
High: torn, ragged outlines.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_lobes:
Large bulges in the hole outline.
Low (0): a simple oval outline.
High: lobed, irregular holes.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_meander:
How much a long hole wanders sideways instead of running straight.
Low (0): straight holes.
High: winding, curved holes.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_split_max:
The most pieces a tear can split into, with fabric bridges left between them.
Low (1): one continuous hole per tear.
High: a tear breaks into a row of separate holes.
Allowed range: 1 to 8.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_bridge:
Width of the fabric bridges between the pieces of a split tear.
Low: thin strips of fabric between the pieces.
High: wide bridges, the pieces look like separate holes.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_dir_mode:
How the tears are oriented. Random gives every tear its own direction. Weave Axis follows Hole Dir X / Y / Z.
Random: tears in all directions.
Weave Axis: tears line up with the weave.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_dir_x:
X component of the warp direction (the lengthwise yarn) that tears follow, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (1, 0, 0)
0: no part of the direction along X
1: the direction points along X (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_dir_y:
Y component of the warp direction (the lengthwise yarn) that tears follow, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (1, 0, 0)
0: no part of the direction along Y
1: the direction points along Y (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_dir_z:
Z component of the warp direction (the lengthwise yarn) that tears follow, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (1, 0, 0)
0: no part of the direction along Z
1: the direction points along Z (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hole_dir_jitte:
Random spread around the hole direction, in degrees.
Low (0°): all tears exactly parallel.
High: tears deviate strongly from the weave.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_enable:
Turns Edge Tears on: slits that start at the border of the cloth and taper inward
Off: no edge tears, the values are kept
on: torn slits along the borders
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_amount:
Number of slits along all borders.
Low (0): no edge tears.
High: a densely torn border.
Allowed range: 0 to 1000.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_spacing_j:
How unevenly the slits are spaced along the border.
Low (0): evenly spaced slits.
High: slits in clusters with long untorn stretches.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_length_mi:
Shortest slit, how far it runs into the cloth, in cm. Keep it at or below Length Max
Low: short nicks are possible
High: every slit runs deep
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_length_ma:
Longest slit, how far it runs into the cloth, in cm. Keep it at or above Length Min
low: only short nicks in the border
High: long tears deep into the cloth are possible
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_width_min:
Narrowest slit at the border, in cm. Keep it at or below Width Max
Low: thin cuts are possible
High: every slit is wide
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_width_max:
Widest slit at the border, in cm. Keep it at or above Width Min
Low: only thin cuts
high: wide V-shaped gaps are possible
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_taper:
How quickly a slit narrows from the border to its tip.
Low (0): parallel sides, a slot.
High: a slit that closes quickly into a sharp point.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_jagged:
Raggedness of the slit sides.
Low (0): clean cut sides.
High: torn, ragged sides.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_meander:
How much a slit wanders sideways.
Low (0): straight slits.
High: winding slits.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_edge_angle_jit:
Random spread of the slit direction away from square to the border, in degrees.
Low (0°): slits run straight in from the border.
High: slits run in at slanted angles.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_threads_enable:
Adds thread geometry around the tears: bridging, broken and frayed threads
Off: clean holes without threads
On: threads around the holes, set in the three boxes below
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_radius:
Thickness of a thread.
Low: fine fibres; very thin threads need a high Resolution.
High: thick, clearly visible threads.
Allowed range: 1e-05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_sides:
Number of sides of a thread tube.
Low (3): triangular threads, light mesh.
High (12): round threads, heavy mesh. Only visible in extreme close-ups (images use Thread Radius 0.15 cm).
Allowed range: 3 to 12.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_spacing:
Distance between neighbouring threads along the rim.
Low: many threads close together.
High: few, widely spaced threads.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_bridge_enable:
Threads that still span the gap of a tear from one side to the other
off: no spanning threads
On: threads cross the holes
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_bridge_share:
Share of the possible threads that bridge the gap.
Low (0): no bridges.
High: many threads across every hole.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_sag:
How much a bridging thread hangs down under gravity.
Low (0): taut, straight threads.
High: threads sag in loose arcs.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_skew:
How far a bridging thread runs at an angle instead of straight across.
Low (0): threads cross straight.
High: threads cross at slanted angles.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_wobble:
Small waves along a thread.
Low (0): smooth threads.
High: kinked, wavy threads.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_broken_enable:
Threads broken in the middle that dangle from the rim
Off: no loose ends
On: broken threads hang out of the holes
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_broken_share:
Share of the possible threads that are broken and dangling.
Low (0): no broken threads.
High: many loose threads.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_droop:
How much a broken thread hangs down.
Low (0): broken threads stick out straight.
High: broken threads hang down.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_curl:
How much a broken thread curls at its end.
Low (0): straight loose ends.
High: curled, kinked ends.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_thread_taper:
How much a broken thread thins toward its end.
Low (0): the thread keeps its thickness to the end.
High (1): the end thins to a point.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_fray_enable:
Short fibre stubs along the torn rim
Off: a clean rim
on: a fuzzy, frayed rim
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_fray_spacing:
Distance between frayed fibres along a torn cloth edge, in cm.
Low: a dense, fuzzy edge.
High: only a few fibres far apart.
Allowed range: 0.01 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_fray_length_mi:
Shortest frayed stub, in cm. Keep it at or below Fray Length Max
Low: very short fuzz is possible
High: every stub is long
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_fray_length_ma:
Longest frayed stub, in cm. Keep it at or above Fray Length Min
low: only a short fuzz
High: long fringes are possible
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hang_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit hang enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use hang enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hang_amount:
How many loose threads hang from torn cloth edges.
0: no hanging threads.
High (2000): a thick fringe of threads.
Allowed range: 0 to 2000.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hang_length_mi:
Shortest hanging thread, in cm.
Low: some threads are just stubs.
High: even the shortest thread is long.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_hang_length_ma:
Longest hanging thread, in cm.
Low: all threads stay short.
High: some threads hang far down.
Allowed range: 0 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_gravity_x:
X component of the direction that sagging and drooping threads hang toward, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, -1), down
0: no part of the direction along X
1: the direction points along X (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_gravity_y:
Y component of the direction that sagging and drooping threads hang toward, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, -1), down
0: no part of the direction along Y
1: the direction points along Y (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_gravity_z:
Z component of the direction that sagging and drooping threads hang toward, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, -1), down
0: no part of the direction along Z
1: the direction points along Z (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: -100 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fabric_max_threads:
Limit on the total number of threads, shared between all tears. Keeps the mesh light.
Low: only a few threads per hole.
High: the spacing and share settings alone decide the number.
Allowed range: 0 to 50000.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_enable:
Turns broken-out concrete patches on for this object.
Off: no concrete damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: spalled patches and cracks are added.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_seed:
Changes the random placement and shape of the patches without changing their size or number.
Every number gives another arrangement.
There is no low or high, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_mode:
Choose Mode. Automatic: Area-weighted spall patches; Paint: Damage follows linked Grease Pencil or Curve strokes.
Automatic: Area-weighted spall patches.
Paint: Damage follows linked Grease Pencil or Curve strokes.
ProjectDamageProps.concrete_avoid:
