ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_dish:
How deep the plate is dented in around the hole, x size.
Low (0): a flat plate around the hole.
High: a deep dent around the hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_dish_wid:
Radius of the dent, x size.
Low: a tight dent.
High: a wide, shallow dish.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_lip_heig:
Height of the raised burr crown on the entry side, x size.
Low (0): no crown.
High: a tall crown of torn metal.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_lip_widt:
Width of the crown, x size.
Low: a narrow crown.
High: a wide crown.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_petals:
Number of torn petals in the crown.
Low: a few large petals.
High: many narrow petals.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_petal_te:
How deep the tears between petals go.
Low (0): a closed ring.
High (1): separate petals torn apart.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_curl:
How much the crown curls in over the hole.
Low (0): the crown stands straight.
High (1): the petals curl over the hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_exit_bur:
Length of the petals on the exit (back) side, x size. Shown from the back.
Low (0): a clean exit hole.
High: long petals bent outward on the back.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_metal_dent_cha:
Share of shots that only dent the plate, even if it is thin enough to go through.
Low (0): every shot makes a hole.
High (1): only dents, no holes.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_grain_mode:
Wood. How the direction of the wood grain is found
Longest Axis: the grain runs along the longest side of the object
Fixed Axis: the grain follows Grain X / Y / Z
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_grain_x:
X component of the wood grain direction (Fixed Axis). Splinters and splits run along it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along X
1: the direction points along X (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_grain_y:
Y component of the wood grain direction (Fixed Axis). Splinters and splits run along it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along Y
1: the direction points along Y (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_grain_z:
Z component of the wood grain direction (Fixed Axis). Splinters and splits run along it, in object space. Set X, Y and Z together, they form one direction. Default (0, 0, 1)
0: no part of the direction along Z
1: the direction points along Z (mixed values give a diagonal)
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_crush:
Depth of the crushed funnel around the hole, x size.
Low (0): a clean hole.
High: a deep crushed funnel.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_splinter:
How far splinter strips reach along the grain, x size.
Low (0): no splinters.
High: long splinters along the grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_fiber_wid:
Width of the splinter strips, x size.
Low: thin fibres.
High: wide strips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_exit_scal:
Radius of the tear-out on the back, x size.
Low: a small exit hole.
High: a large torn-out area on the back.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_exit_dept:
Depth of the exit tear-out, as a share of the board thickness.
Low: a shallow tear-out.
High: a tear-out almost through the board.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_slivers:
Number of loose splinters added at the exit tear-out.
Low (0): no loose splinters.
High: many splinters sticking out.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_sliver_le:
Length of the loose splinters, x size.
Low: short splinters.
High: long splinters.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_split_cha:
Chance of a split along the grain through the hole.
Low (0): no splits.
High (1): every hole has a split.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_wood_split_len:
Length of the split, x size (images use Split Chance 1).
Low: a short split.
High: a long crack along the grain.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_spall_cha:
Share of shots that blow out a conical spall crater.
Low (0): only small bore holes.
High (1): every shot leaves a wide crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_spall_sca:
Radius of the spall crater, x size.
Low: a small crater around the hole.
High: a wide crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_spall_dep:
Depth of the cone in the centre, x size.
Low: a shallow, dish-like crater.
High: a deep, steep cone.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_skin_dept:
A shallow outer terrace where the surface skin flaked off, x size.
Low (0): the crater starts directly at the surface.
High: a wide stepped terrace around the crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_bore_dept:
Depth of the bore hole below the cone, x size.
Low: a shallow dent in the crater floor.
High: a deep, dark bore hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_jagged:
Lobed, ragged outline of the spall.
Low (0): a round crater.
High: a ragged, lobed crater.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_roughness:
Pitted, shell-like (conchoidal) crater floor.
Low (0): a smooth cone.
High: a rough, broken floor.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_aggregate:
Size of the pits in the crater floor, x size.
Low: a fine floor.
High: coarse pits like exposed gravel.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_exit_scal:
Size of the exit crater on the back face compared with the entry (back of a 3 cm wall, Penetration 5 cm).
Low: a small exit hole.
High: a wide blow-out on the back, as in real concrete.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_cracks:
Number of hairline cracks running out of each spall.
Low (0): no cracks.
High: a star of cracks around each crater.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_conc_crack_len:
Length of the cracks, x spall radius.
Low: short cracks inside the crater area.
High: long cracks reaching far out.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_crack_width:
Width of the cracks (images use 4 cracks).
Low: hairlines.
High: open cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bullet_crack_depth:
Depth of the cracks.
Low: surface cracks.
High: deep cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_enable:
Turns explosion damage to a building on for this object.
Off: no blast damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: blast openings are cut at the empties.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_seed:
Shuffles the broken outline, bricks and cracks of the blast without changing their size.
Every number gives a different random arrangement.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_avoid:
Keeps blast damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: the blast may break protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_detail:
tessellation of the core blob and the cut outlines (0.25.4).
Minimum: Coarser, faster geometry with less small detail.
Maximum: Finer, heavier geometry; the active geometry budget may limit the requested detail.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_radius_scale:
Makes every blast bigger or smaller at once.
Low: all blasts shrink.
High: all blasts grow.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_proximity:
How far from the building a blast empty may be and still do damage, compared with its radius.
Low: only blasts right at the wall count.
High: blasts far from the wall still leave weaker damage.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_prox_shrink:
How much a far-away, weak blast also makes a smaller hole. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: a weak blast keeps its full size.
1: a weak blast makes a much smaller hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_jagged:
How irregular the outline of the blast hole is.
0: a clean rounded hole.
High: a lumpy, torn outline.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_noise_scale:
Size of the lumps on the blast outline, compared with the blast radius.
Low: many small bites.
High: a few big lobes.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_floor_height:
Height from one floor to the next in the building.
Low: low storeys, many floors in the hole.
High: tall storeys, few floors in the hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_floor_offset:
Height of the first floor above the bottom of the object. Older effect, kept for old projects.
Low: the first floor sits at the very bottom.
High: the floors are shifted upward.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_slab_thickness:
Thickness of the concrete floors.
Low: thin floors.
High: thick, heavy floors.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_wall_depth:
Thickness of the outer brick wall.
Low: a thin skin of brick.
High: a thick wall with deep hole sides.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_core_size:
Size of the zone at the heart of the blast where everything is gone, floors included.
Low: a small clean-through hole.
High: a huge void through several storeys.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_room_size:
Size of the zone where rooms are emptied but the floors stay as ledges.
Low: little is gutted around the core.
High: rooms are emptied far around the core.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_room_facets:
Number of corners in the outline of each gutted storey. Older effect, kept for old projects.
Low: a simple boxy outline.
High: an outline with many straight broken wall pieces.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_partition_spaci:
Distance between the inner walls that show inside the hole.
0: no inner walls.
Low: many small rooms. High: a few large rooms.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_partition_thick:
Thickness of the inner walls.
Low: thin partitions.
High: thick inner walls.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_slab_break:
How far the floors break off beyond the core, different for each floor. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: floors end at the edge of the core.
1: floors are broken back far and unevenly.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_slab_droop:
How much the broken floor ends slope downward. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: floors end with a square cut.
1: floor ends hang down in a slant.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_wall_size:
Size of the opening in the outer brick wall.
Low: a small hole in the facade.
High: a wide gap in the facade.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_fringe:
Width of the belt around the opening with loose and missing bricks. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: a clean edge.
High: a wide belt of damaged brickwork.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_fringe_density:
Share of bricks in that belt that are knocked in.
0: all bricks stay.
1: almost every brick in the belt is missing.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_spall_reach:
How far around the opening the plaster is blown off.
Low: plaster is lost only at the edge.
High: plaster is gone far across the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_spall_cover:
How much of that area actually loses its plaster.
0: plaster stays everywhere.
1: the whole area is bare brick.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_brick_length:
Length of one brick.
Low: short bricks.
High: long bricks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_brick_height:
Height of one brick.
Low: flat bricks.
High: tall blocks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_joint_width:
Width of the mortar between bricks.
Low: tight joints.
High: wide joints.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_joint_depth:
How deep the mortar joints are scraped out where the plaster is gone.
0: joints flush with the bricks.
High: deep grooves between bricks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_brick_jitter:
How uneven the stepped brick edge of the opening is.
0: a regular staircase edge.
High: a random, toothy edge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_plaster_depth:
Thickness of the plaster layer that breaks off.
Low: a thin skin.
High: a thick layer with a clear step.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_crack_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit crack enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use crack enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_crack_count:
Number of stair-step cracks running out of the opening on each wall.
0: no cracks.
High: many cracks radiating from the hole.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_crack_length:
Length of those cracks, compared with the blast radius.
Low: short cracks near the hole.
High: cracks run far across the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_crack_width:
How wide the cracks open at the surface.
Low: hairline cracks.
High: wide open cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.blast_crack_depth:
Depth of the cracks.
Low: shallow cracks.
High: deep cracks; careful with thin walls.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_enable:
Turns cracked and broken ground on for this object.
Off: no ground damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: cracks and plates are added to the ground.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_seed:
Shuffles the layout of cracks and plates without changing their size.
Every number gives a different random arrangement.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_mode:
0 automatic, 1 paint (grease pencil strokes).
Automatic: Automatic.
Paint: Paint.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_avoid:
Keeps ground damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: cracks may run over protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_detail:
Density of the grid used for the damaged areas and the step along the cracks (0.05 to 4, default 1; higher values cost more time).
Low (0.5): plates and crack walls are coarser and more faceted.
High (2): finer plate edges and smoother crack walls; the layout stays the same. The difference is small at this distance.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_up_x:
object-space "up": cracks are cut looking down it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative X.
Maximum: Point toward positive X. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_up_y:
object-space "up": cracks are cut looking down it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Y.
Maximum: Point toward positive Y. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_up_z:
object-space "up": cracks are cut looking down it.
Minimum: Point this direction component toward negative Z.
Maximum: Point toward positive Z. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_max_slope:
Faces steeper than this angle (in degrees, against the up direction) are not ground and get no damage (default 35). The image uses a slab whose back half is a 30 degree ramp.
Low (20): only the flat front half is cracked; the ramp stays clean.
High (35 or 60): the ramp counts as ground as well and gets cracks too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_amount:
Number of sites, each one crack system (default 4, at most 200). Fewer are placed only when there is no room left on the ground.
Low (1): a single crack system.
High (10): the slab is covered with crack networks and damaged areas.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_size_min:
Smallest site radius: how far the crack network of a site reaches (default 80). Each site gets a radius between Size Min and Size Max; the damaged area is Area Size times this radius.
Low (30): some sites are small, with small damaged areas.
High (150): all sites are large; the damaged areas grow.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_size_max:
Largest site radius (default 180). If it is below Size Min, the two are swapped.
Low (100): smaller sites with smaller damaged areas.
High (360): large sites; the layout spreads out and the damaged areas get bigger.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_area_chance:
Share of sites that get a damaged area (plates, maybe a pothole) in their middle (0 to 1, default 0.6).
Low (0): only crack networks, no damaged areas.
High (1): every site has a damaged area.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_area_size:
Radius of a damaged area as a share of its site radius (default 0.35).
Low (0.2): small patches of plates.
High (0.6): large damaged areas that take up much of the site.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_area_stretch:
Largest elongation of an automatic damaged area (1 to 6, default 1.5); each area gets a random stretch between 1 and this value in a random direction.
Low (1): round areas.
High (4): long, narrow strips of damage.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_paint_snap:
How far above or below the ground a stroke point may be and still be used (default 10). The image uses strokes drawn 8 cm above the ground.
Low (5 cm): the strokes are too far away and nothing is cut.
High (10 cm or more): the strokes are used. Raise it for strokes drawn well above the surface; keep it low so strokes do not reach other surfaces below.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_paint_close:
Treats an open stroke whose ends are closer than this share of its length as a closed outline, so it becomes a damaged area (default 0.15; 0 = only strokes marked cyclic are closed).
Low (0): the ring with a gap stays an open stroke and is cut as a curved crack.
High (0.15 and up): the ring is closed and becomes a damaged area of plates with cracks radiating from its rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_paint_jitter:
Sideways wiggle added to a drawn crack (default 1.2; 0 = the crack follows the stroke exactly).
Low (0): a clean crack exactly along the stroke.
High (5 cm): a ragged, zigzag crack around the stroke.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_paint_branch:
Multiplies Crack Branch for drawn cracks (default 1).
Low (0): drawn cracks have no side branches.
High (3): many side cracks branch off the drawn crack.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit crack enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use crack enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_amount:
Primary cracks per site (in Paint mode: per drawn area, radiating from its rim; default 3, at most 32).
Low (1): one crack with its branches per site.
High (8): dense networks; cracks start to join each other.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_generati:
How many times side cracks branch off again (default 2, at most 4; 0 = primary cracks only).
Low (0): single cracks without side branches.
High (4): more short side branches; the change from 2 to 4 is small because each generation gets fewer branches.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_length_m:
Shortest primary crack (default 40). Each primary crack gets a length between Crack Length Min and Max, with more short ones than long ones.
Low (10 cm): some cracks are very short.
High (100 cm): all cracks are long.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Longest primary crack (default 140). If it is below the minimum, the two are swapped.
Low (60 cm): short, compact crack networks.
High (300 cm): long cracks that run across the slab and join other networks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_width:
Opening of a primary crack at its widest (default 0.2). Side cracks are narrower.
Low (0.2 cm): hairline cracks, hard to see from a distance.
High (3 cm): wide, open cracks with chipped lips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_width_va:
How much the width changes along a crack (default 0.5).
Low (0): an even width.
High (1.5): the crack swells and narrows along its length.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_taper:
How much a crack thins toward its tips (default 0.85).
Low (0): the crack keeps its width to the end and stops bluntly.
High (0.85): the crack fades out to a hairline at its tips.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_depth:
Depth of the crack groove (default 0.1). The image is a low, grazing view.
Low (0.1 cm): a shallow scratch that hardly casts a shadow.
High (4 cm): deep, dark cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_meander:
Slow side-to-side wandering of the crack direction (default 0.45).
Low (0): straight cracks.
High (1.5): curving, wandering cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_kink:
Sharp, sudden turns of a crack, like the polygonal cracks of concrete slabs (default 0.5; 0 = none).
Low (0): smooth cracks.
High (2): zigzag cracks made of short straight pieces.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_branch:
Side branches per crack (0 to 16, default 3); each generation of side cracks gets 60% of the branches of its parent.
Low (0): bare cracks without branches.
High (10): bushy, tree-like crack networks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_join:
Chance that a crack stops where it runs into another crack, which forms a T-junction (default 0.9). The image uses Crack Branch 8 so more cracks meet.
Low (0): cracks cross each other and run on.
High (0.9): cracks end on the crack they meet; the network looks like real shrinkage cracking. The change is subtle.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_crack_chip:
Chipped, ragged lips along the crack, as a share of the crack width (default 0.6; 0 = clean edges). The image uses Crack Width 2.5 cm.
Low (0): sharp, clean crack edges.
High (2): broken, chipped lips along the crack.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_area_jagged:
Ragged outline of a damaged area (0 to 2, default 0.6). In Paint mode it roughens the drawn outline, but less.
Low (0): a smooth, rounded outline.
High (2): a broken, ragged outline; plates near the edge come apart.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_rim_fade:
Share of the area over which the damage fades in from the outline (0 to 1). The default is 4.4, which is above the top of the range, so it works like 1: the damage fades in over the whole area and is strongest only in the middle.
Low (0): full-strength plates right up to the outline: a sharp-edged patch with deep gaps.
High (4.4 = 1): the plates get gradually deeper toward the centre; the outline blends into the intact ground.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_plate_size:
Plate diameter at the rim of the area (default 14).
Low (7 cm): many small plates.
High (28 cm): a few large slabs.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_plate_center_s:
Plate size in the middle of the area, as a share of Plate Size (default 0.45). Below 1 the core crumbles into smaller pieces.
Low (0.2): a crumbling centre of tiny plates.
High (1): plates of the same size everywhere.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_plate_jagged:
Irregular, warped plate edges (default 0.5).
Low (0): straight, clean plate edges.
High (2): very ragged edges; the plates break up into crumbs.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_gap_width:
Width of the gaps between plates where the damage is fully developed, in the middle (default 1.2).
Low (0.4 cm): hairline joints.
High (3 cm): wide, rounded gaps; the plates look like separate stones.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_gap_depth:
Depth of the gaps between plates (default 3).
Low (1 cm): shallow joints that barely show.
High (8 cm): deep, dark gaps.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_plate_sink:
Largest drop of a plate below the ground (default 1). Each plate sinks by its own random amount.
Low (0): the plates stay level with the ground.
High (4 cm): the plates sit at clearly different heights.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_plate_tilt:
Largest extra drop of the low side of a tilted plate (default 0.8).
Low (0): the plates lie flat.
High (3 cm): the plates tip in different directions; their edges stand out.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_pothole_chance:
Share of damaged areas that become potholes (0 to 1, default 0.2).
Low (0): only plates, no holes.
High (1): every damaged area is a pothole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_pothole_size:
Share of the area, from the centre out, where the plates are gone (default 0.55).
Low (0.2): a small hole in a field of broken plates.
High (0.9): almost the whole area is open, with only a thin ragged rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_pothole_loose:
Chance that a plate just outside the pothole is gone too (default 0.35).
Low (0): a clean outline along whole plates.
High (1): the plates around the hole are gone as well; the hole grows and its rim gets ragged.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_pothole_depth:
Depth of the gravel bed in the pothole (default 3), limited by Thickness Cap.
Low (1 cm): a shallow dip.
High (10 cm): a deep hole with steep walls and a rough gravel floor.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_roughness:
Unevenness of the gravel bed in the pothole (default 0.6; 0 = smooth floor). This is geometry, not shader roughness.
Low (0): a smooth floor.
High (2): a coarse, stony floor.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_aggregate_size:
Size of the pits in the gravel bed (default 1.2).
Low (0.4 cm): fine grit.
High (4 cm): larger, softer dents. The change is small.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_thickness_cap:
Largest pothole depth as a share of the local slab thickness (default 0.7; 0 turns the cap off). The images use Pothole Depth 25 cm on the 30 cm slab.
Low (0.3): the hole stops at 9 cm, with a flat floor.
Default (0.7): the hole stops at 21 cm.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_rubble_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit rubble enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use rubble enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_rubble_amount:
Number of chunks per pothole (default 75, at most 512).
Low (10): a few scattered stones.
High (300): the floor is covered with small chunks.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_rubble_size_mi:
Smallest chunk (default 1). The image uses Rubble Size Max 4 cm.
Low (0.5 cm): many tiny crumbs among the larger chunks.
High (3 cm): all chunks are large.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_rubble_size_ma:
Largest chunk (default 2). If it is below the minimum, the two are swapped.
Low (1.2 cm): small, even grit.
High (6 cm): some big chunks lie in the hole.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_heave_chance:
Share of primary cracks (in Paint mode: drawn cracks) that heave (default 0.15).
Low (0): no heaved cracks.
High (1): every primary crack lifts one side; on the test slab only some cracks are long enough to show it.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_heave_height:
Lift of the raised side at the crack (default 4).
Low (1 cm): a slight step at the crack.
High (12 cm): a tall, tilted slab edge standing up from the crack.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_heave_width:
Width of the tilted band beside the crack (default 45).
Low (15 cm): a narrow, steep ridge.
High (120 cm): a wide, gentle slope.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.ground_heave_gap:
Extra opening of a heaved crack (default 1.5).
Low (0): the raised side stays tight against the crack.
High (6 cm): a wide open gap below the raised edge.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_enable:
Turns broken plaster over brickwork on for this object.
Off: no brick damage is made, the settings are kept.
On: patches with bare bricks are added.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_seed:
Changes where the patches go and which bricks break. The images use Amount 3.
Every number gives another arrangement.
There is no low or high.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_mode:
0 automatic, 1 paint (grease pencil strokes).
Automatic: Automatic.
Paint: Paint.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_avoid:
Keeps brick damage away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: patches may land on protected faces too.
On: protected faces stay untouched.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_detail:
Octaves of the noise (1 to 8, default 4).
Low (1): soft lumps.
High (8): fine grain on top.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_amount:
Number of patches (default 3).
Low (1): one patch.
High (6): six patches.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_size_min:
Smallest size of a broken patch.
Low: some patches are tiny.
High: even the smallest patch is big.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_size_max:
Largest size of a broken patch.
Low: all patches stay small.
High: some patches grow large.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_lobes:
Overlapping blobs per patch outline (default 4).
Low (1): a single rounded patch.
High (8): a cloud-like patch.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_stretch:
Largest elongation (default 1.6; 1 is about round).
Low (1): a compact patch.
High (4): a long band.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_edge_bias:
Pull of the patches toward sharp edges and corners (default 0.2). The images use Amount 4.
Low (0): anywhere on the face.
High (1): along the edges of the wall.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_paint_radius:
How wide the damage is along a line you drew.
Low: a thin broken strip.
High: a wide broken band.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_paint_snap:
How far from the surface a drawn line may be and still count.
Low: only lines drawn right on the wall are used.
High: lines floating far off the wall are used too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_paint_close:
How big a gap between the two ends of a drawn line is closed automatically, compared with the line length.
0: only lines you closed yourself become patches.
High: almost any curved line is closed into a patch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_render_min:
Minimum depth of plaster in front of the brickwork, in centimeters.
Set Plaster Min and Plaster Max to zero for bare brick. Raise Plaster Min for a thicker minimum coat.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_render_max:
Upper depth of the front of the brickwork below the wall surface, in centimeters.
A value equal to Plaster Min gives a fixed depth. A higher value lets patches recess farther.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_jagged:
How ragged the outline is (default 0.6).
Low (0): a smooth oval.
High (2): a torn outline with loose islands.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_outline_scale:
Feature size of the outline noise (default 1).
Low (0.3): many small bites.
High (3): broad bulges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_crumble:
Fine breakup of the render rim (default 0.5).
Low (0): a clean rim.
High (2): a crumbled rim with flecks off it.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_crumble_size:
Feature size of the crumble (default 1.5 cm). The images use Crumble 1.5.
Low (0.5 cm): fine grit.
High (5 cm): large bites.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_terraces:
Number of plaster coats that break off in steps.
Low (1): one single layer.
High (4): a staircase of several coats.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_terrace_skin:
How much of the plaster thickness belongs to the outer coat.
Low: a thin outer skin over a thick base.
High: a thick outer coat over a thin base.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_terrace_inset:
How far each deeper coat breaks back inside the one above, compared with the patch size.
Low: the coats end almost together.
High: wide ledges between the coats.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_wall_soft:
0 = sheer broken render walls, 1 = soft sloped walls.
Minimum: Sheer broken render walls, 1 = soft sloped walls.
Maximum: Soft sloped walls.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_roughness:
Uneven floor on the render (default 0.3). In our Carved close-ups the change was too small to see, so there is no image.
Low (0): a smooth floor.
High (1.5): a bumpy floor.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_render_stick:
Share of the exposed bricks still smeared with render scraps (0 to 1, default 0.15). The images use Carved.
Low (0): clean bricks.
High (0.6): lumps of render on many bricks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_thickness_cap:
Largest cut depth as a share of the local wall thickness, outside holes (default 0.85; 0 = off). In our test on a 14 cm wall the brick pocket opened through the wall at 0.2, 0.85 and 0 alike, so the cap did not stop it there; no image.
Low: a shallower cut where the wall is thin.
High (0 = off): no limit.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_bond:
Running (default, stretchers offset by Bond Offset), Stack, English, Flemish or Header.
The images show the five bonds in the same patch.
Header shows only the short ends of the bricks.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_brick_length:
Stretcher face length (default 25 cm).
Low (18 cm): short bricks.
High (40 cm): long bricks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_brick_height:
Course height without the bed joint (default 6.5 cm).
Low (4 cm): thin courses.
High (12 cm): tall blocks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_brick_width:
Depth of the brick layer into the wall (default 12 cm); a header face is (length - mortar) / 2 long.
Low (6 cm): a thin layer.
High (20 cm): a deep layer.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_mortar:
Joint width, bed and head (default 1 cm).
Low (0.3 cm): tight joints.
High (2.5 cm): wide joints.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_mortar_depth:
How far the generated mortar sits behind the brick faces (default 0.6 cm). The change was too small to see in our images.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_brick_scale:
Multiplies length, height, width, mortar and mortar depth (default 1).
Low (0.6): small bricks.
High (1.6): large bricks; few fit in the patch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.brick_bond_offset:
Running bond: course-to-course offset, times the brick length (default 0.5 = half bond).
Low (0): stacked joints.
High (0.5): half-bond.

ProjectDamageProps.brick_face_jitter:

ProjectDamageProps.glass_paint_point_hol:

ProjectDamageProps.glass_max_cracks:

ProjectDamageProps.glass_thickness_logic:

ProjectDamageProps.glass_auto_hole:

ProjectDamageProps.glass_auto_hole_thick:

0: the limit is chosen for you.
High: even thick glass is knocked through.

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_enable:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_seed:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_avoid:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_detail:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_up_x:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_up_y:
object-space "up": strokes are dropped onto the ground along -up.

Maximum: Point toward positive Y. Only the vector direction matters; avoid a zero vector.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_up_z:
object-space "up": strokes are dropped onto the ground along -up.

Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_width:

High (280 cm): a wide gap.

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_width_random:

High (1): the chasm swells and pinches along its length.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_depth:
Depth at the centre line (default 450, times Master Scale), limited by Thickness Cap. Seen in section.
Low (150 cm): a shallow trench.
High (700 cm): a deep, narrow slot.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_depth_random:
Variation of the depth along the path (0 to 1, default 0.25). The section shows only one place on the path, so the change is small.
Low (0): an even depth.
High (1): the floor rises and falls along the fissure.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_taper:
Share of the path length at each end that narrows down to a crack (0 to 0.5, default 0.15).
Low (0): the chasm stops abruptly at full width.
High (0.5): the chasm narrows over the whole path and is wide only in the middle.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_jagged:
Irregularity of the rim (0 to 2, default 0.6).
Low (0): a smooth, even rim.
High (2): a broken rim with angular bites.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_edge_scale:
Size of the rim noise, as a share of the width (default 1).
Low (0.3): fine, frequent notches.
High (3): long, gentle bends; the rim looks smoother.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_wall_lean:
How far the walls lean in or out, as a share of the half width (0 to 1, default 0.3). Leaning walls give undercuts.
Low (0): straight, vertical walls.
High (1): the walls lean, so the chasm narrows or widens with depth.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_wall_rough:
Roughness of the walls and the floor (0 to 2, default 0.5; 0 = smooth).
Low (0): smooth walls.
High (2): rough, bumpy walls. The change shows best in shading.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_floor_shape:
Shape of the bottom (0 = flat floor, 1 = sharp V; default 0.5).
Low (0): a rounded, flat-bottomed trench.
High (1): the walls meet in a sharp V.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_thickness_cap:
Largest depth as a share of the local thickness of the object (0 to 0.98, default 0.85). The images use Depth 900 cm (1.8 m with Master Scale 20%) on the 1.5 m slab.
Low (0.3): the chasm stops at 45 cm.
High (0.85): the chasm goes down to 1.27 m and stops short of the bottom.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_enable:
Enable this feature for the current source. Disable to omit it without losing its stored settings.
Off: omit slab enable while keeping its stored settings.
On: use slab enable with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_rows:
Rows of slabs on each side (1 to 3, default 2).

High (3): a wide band of broken ground; the outer rows are narrower and less tilted.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_length_m:
Shortest slab along the fissure (default 90).
Low (40 cm): some short slabs.
High (200 cm): only long slabs.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Longest slab along the fissure (default 240).

High (500 cm): long slabs, fewer cross cracks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_width_mi:
Narrowest slab, measured outward from the rim, first row (default 70).
Low (30): some narrow slabs.
High (150): wider slabs. The change is small next to Slab Width Max.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_width_ma:
Widest slab, outward from the rim (default 170).
Low (100): a narrow band of slabs.
High (340): wide slabs reaching far out into the ground.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_row_fall:
Each further row gets this share of the width and tilt of the row before it (0.05 to 1.5, default 0.55).
Low (0.2): the outer rows are thin and nearly flat.
High (1.2): the outer rows are as wide and tilted as the first, or more.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_thick_mi:
Thinnest slab (default 40). Seen in section.
Low (15 cm): thin plates.
High (80 cm): thick blocks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_thick_ma:
Thickest slab (default 90). Seen in section.
Low (50 cm): thinner slabs.
High (180 cm): massive blocks.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_tilt_min:

High (25): every slab is clearly tilted.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_tilt_max:

Low (10): a gentle buckle.
High (60): slabs stand up steeply.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_sink_chance:
Share of slabs that drop into the fissure instead of lifting (0 to 1, default 0.25).
Low (0): every slab lifts.
High (1): every slab drops into the chasm.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_roll:
Random roll about the axis across the fissure, in degrees (default 7).
Low (0): the slabs tilt only toward the chasm.
High (25): the slabs twist sideways as well.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_flat_chance:
Share of slabs left untilted, so only their cracks show (0 to 1, default 0.15).
Low (0): every slab is tilted.
High (1): all slabs stay flat; only the cracks around them are cut.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_side_bias:
Which side lifts more (-1 to 1, default 0.3). Positive values lift the right-hand side, looking along the path direction; the slider starts at 0, type a negative value for the left side.
Low (-1): the left side lifts and the right side stays nearly flat.
High (1): the right side lifts and the left side stays nearly flat.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_gap:
Width of the cracks between and behind the slabs (default 2.5).
Low (0.5 cm): tight cracks.
High (8 cm): wide, dark gaps around each slab.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_jagged:
Ragged slab outlines (0 to 2, default 0.5).
Low (0): clean, straight slab edges.
High (2): broken, crumbling slab edges.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_slab_skew:
Slant of the cross cracks between slabs (0 to 2, default 0.35; 0 = square).
Low (0): cross cracks at right angles to the fissure.
High (1.5): slanted cross cracks; wedge-shaped slabs.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_enable:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_densit:
Branches per 100 units of path, both sides together (default 0.6).

Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_length:
Shortest branch (default 120, times Master Scale).
Low (40 cm): some very short branches.
High (300 cm): all branches are long.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.

Longest branch (default 450, times Master Scale).

High (900 cm): long cracks that reach far into the ground.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_width:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_depth:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_meande:
Wandering of a branch (0 to 2, default 0.5; 0 = straight).
Low (0): straight branches.
High (2): curling, twisting branches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_angle:
Largest deviation from a right angle to the fissure, in degrees (0 to 85, default 45).
Low (0): all branches leave the fissure at right angles.
High (85): branches leave at any angle, some running almost along the fissure.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_branch_fork:
Chance that a branch forks once (0 to 1, default 0.35).
Low (0): single branches.
High (1): every branch splits in two.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_rubble_enable:

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_rubble_densit:
How many loose chunks lie inside the fissure.

ProjectDamageProps.fissure_rubble_size_m:
Smallest chunk, compared with the width of the fissure.

High: even the smallest chunk is big.

High: some chunks almost fill the gap.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.fissure_rubble_wedged:
Share of chunks stuck between the walls instead of lying on the bottom.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_enable:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_avoid:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_detail:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_angle:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_drawn_only:

On: use drawn only with the controls below.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_paint_radius:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_paint_align:
max angle between stroke and edge, degrees.

Maximum: Rotate or tilt toward the upper end; angles are not a damage-strength multiplier.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_paint_cover:
How much of an edge your stroke must run along for the edge to be picked.

High: the stroke must follow almost the whole edge.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_paint_partial:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_paint_taper:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_max_turn:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_profile:

Chamfer: Chamfer.
Round: Round.
Cove: Cove.
Step: Step.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_roundness:

2: a round quarter circle. High (4): almost square again.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_fillet_top:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_fillet_side:
How rounded the bevel is where it meets the side face. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: a hard line.
1: a smooth blend into the side face.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_size_mode:
Choose Size Mode. Units: Units; Relative: Relative.
Units: Units.
Relative: Relative.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_size_top:
How far the bevel reaches onto the top face, in cm.

High: a wide worn band on top.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_size_side:
How far the bevel reaches down the side face, in cm.
Low: a thin worn line.
High: a wide worn band on the side.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.bevel_max_share:

High: bevels may eat most of a narrow part.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_taper:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_round_corners:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_uneven_sca:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_rough:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_chips:

Maximum: More chips per unit of bevelled edge.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_chip_min:

High: even the smallest chip is big.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_chip_max:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_chip_depth:

High: deep bites.

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_chip_stret:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_mask_noise:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_wear_mask_scale:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_up_y:

ProjectDamageProps.bevel_up_z:
object-space up: picks the "top" face.

High: a dense band of scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_max_scratches:
Hard limit on the number of scratches over all strokes, shared evenly by stroke length.
Low: the band thins out even with a high Density.
High (600): Density alone decides the number.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_spread:
The farthest a scratch can land from its stroke.
Low: a narrow band tight on the stroke.
High: a wide band of scratches around the stroke.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_falloff:
How the scratches are spread across the band.
Low (1): even density over the whole band width.
High: scratches crowd near the stroke and thin out to the sides.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_angle_jitter:
Spread of the scratch direction around the stroke direction, in degrees.
Low (0°): all scratches run parallel to the stroke.
High: scratches point in many directions.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_cross_share:
Share of scratches at a completely random angle, crossing the band.
Low (0): no crossing scratches.
High: many scratches cut across the band.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_along:
Share of scratches placed exactly on the stroke and along it, as if drawn with a point.
Low (0): all scratches are scattered around the stroke.
High (1): the scratches line up on the stroke itself.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_paint_snap:
How far a stroke can be from the surface and still be projected onto it.
Low: only strokes drawn right on the surface are used.
High: strokes away from the surface are also used; they may reach other parts of the object.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_length_min:
Shortest scratch, in cm. Keep it at or below Length Max
Low: short nicks are possible
High: no short scratches, every scratch is long
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_length_max:
Longest scratch, in cm. Keep it at or above Length Min
low: only short nicks
High: long scratches are possible
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_length_bias:
Share of short scratches within the length range.
Low (0): mostly long scratches.
High (1): mostly short scratches; 0.5 is an even mix.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_width:
Width of a groove at its widest point.
Low: hairline scratches.
High: wide grooves.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_width_var:
Random variation of the width from scratch to scratch.
Low (0): every scratch has the same width.
High (1): a mix of thin and wide scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_depth:
Depth of a groove at its deepest point.
Low: scratches that barely break the surface.
High: deep cuts.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_depth_var:
Random variation of the depth from scratch to scratch.
Low (0): every scratch has the same depth.
High (1): a mix of shallow and deep scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_profile:
The cross-section of the groove.
V Groove: a sharp groove, like a cut with a point.
U Groove: a rounded groove, like a dragged blunt object.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_taper:
Share of the length at each end where the scratch narrows to nothing (0 to 0.5).
Low (0): blunt ends, the groove starts and stops at full width.
High (0.5): the scratch narrows over its whole length, a needle shape.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_gouge:
A deep start that fades out toward the end, like a point dragged across the surface.
Low (0): the depth is even along the scratch.
High (1): a deep start and a shallow tail.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_curve:
How much a scratch bends over its length.
Low (0): straight scratches.
High: clearly curved scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_wobble:
Small sideways waver along the scratch, as a share of its length.
Low (0): a clean line.
High: a shaky, wavering line.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_gaps:
How much a scratch skips, leaving a broken line.
Low (0): continuous scratches.
High: dashed, intermittent scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_wrap_angle:
A scratch stops where the surface turns by more than this angle, in degrees.
Low: scratches stop at any small bend.
High (140°): scratches run over sharp edges onto the next face. On the test block the 90° edges showed no difference, so there is no image.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_bundle_chance:
Share of scratches that become a bundle of parallel lines.
Low (0): single lines only.
High (1): every scratch is a bundle.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_bundle_min:
Fewest lines in one bundle. Keep it at or below Bundle Max
Low: bundles can be just two lines
High: every bundle has many lines
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_bundle_max:
Most lines in one bundle. Keep it at or above Bundle Min
low: narrow bundles of few lines
High: wide bundles of many lines are possible
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_bundle_gap:
Distance between the lines of a bundle.
Low: tight lines that almost merge.
High: clearly separate parallel lines.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_bundle_thin:
Width and depth of bundle lines compared with a normal scratch.
Low: very fine bundle lines.
High (1): bundle lines as strong as a single scratch.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_scuff_enable:
Adds the scuff band around the scratches.
Off: grooves only.
On: a very shallow band around each groove.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_scuff_width:
Width of the band as a multiple of the groove width.
Low: a narrow band hugging the groove.
High: a wide band around the groove.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_scuff_depth:
Depth of the band. Keep it tiny, it is meant for the material, not for relief.
Low: the band is only a selection.
High: the band becomes a visible shallow dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_mask_falloff:
Width of the soft fade at the edge of the scratch mask that materials can use.
Low: a hard mask edge.
High: a soft, gradual mask edge. The geometry does not change.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_size_scale:
Multiplies the length, width and depth of all scratches in every style.
Low: tiny, barely visible scratches.
High: long, wide, deep scratches.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.scratch_mode:
How a stroke is turned into scratches. Scatter places many scratches around each stroke. Single Stroke uses the drawn path itself as one scratch.
Scatter: a band of many short scratches along each stroke.
Single Stroke: exactly one scratch per stroke, following your hand. The placement sliders are ignored.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_enable:
Turns dents in sheet metal on for this object.
Off: no dents are made, the settings are kept.
On: the metal is dented at the impact objects.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_seed:
Shuffles the folds and wrinkles of the dents without changing their size.
Every number gives a different random arrangement.
There is no low or high here, only different variants.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_avoid:
Keeps dents away from the faces you marked as Avoid.
Off: protected faces may be dented too.
On: protected faces stay smooth.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_style:
Choose Style. Impact: Impact; Crush: Crush.
Impact: Impact.
Crush: Crush.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_edge_length:
Sets edge length. Increase for a larger length; displayed centimeter lengths follow Master Scale. Check local mesh thickness when increasing depth.
Minimum: Smaller cells or edges: finer, heavier geometry.
Maximum: Larger cells or edges: coarser, faster geometry that may lose small features.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_detail:
multiplies the resolution (2 = half edge length).
Minimum: Coarser, faster geometry with less small detail.
Maximum: Finer, heavier geometry; the active geometry budget may limit the requested detail.
Allowed range: 0.05 to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_max_tris:
triangle budget of the refined region.
Minimum: A strict limit: less generated detail or fewer elements, with lower processing cost.
Maximum: Allow more geometry or elements; updates and memory use can increase.
Allowed range: 0 to 2.14748e+09.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_depth_scale:
How deep the dent is compared with how far the impact object sinks into the metal.
Low: a shallower dent than the object.
1: the metal wraps the object exactly. High: a deeper dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_clearance:
Extra gap pushed between the metal and the impact object. Older effect, kept for old projects.
0: the metal touches the object.
High: the metal is pushed clear of the object.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_proximity:
How near an impact object must come to leave a dent without touching.
0: only real contact dents the metal.
High: near misses leave dents too.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_proximity_depth:
Depth of the dent where an impact object only just touches.
0: no dent at a light touch.
High: even a light touch leaves a clear dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_falloff:
How much wider the dent gets as it gets deeper.
Low: narrow, sharp dents.
High: wide, soft dents.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_falloff_min:
Smallest width of a dent, even a very shallow one. Older effect, kept for old projects.
Low: tiny dings are possible.
High: every dent is at least a wide dimple.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_radius_max:
The widest any dent may become.
Low: all dents stay local.
High: big dents may spread across the panel.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_profile:
0 = soft round bowl, 1 = sharp cone with a creased rim.
Minimum: Soft round bowl, 1 = sharp cone with a creased rim.
Maximum: Sharp cone with a creased rim.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_bulge:
Raised ring pushed up just outside the dent.
0: no ring.
High: a clear ridge around the dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_sheet_thickness:
Thickness of the metal sheet.
Low: thin tin.
High: thick plate.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_thickness_cap:
Stops dents from going too deep in thin parts, as a share of the local thickness.
0: no limit.
Low: dents stay shallow. High: dents may use most of the thickness.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crease:
Height of the buckles around the dent.
0: a smooth dent rim.
High: strong buckles around the dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crease_spacing:
Distance between the buckles around the rim of the dent.
Low: many fine buckles.
High: a few big buckles.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crease_length:
How far the buckles run outward from the dent.
Low: short buckles at the rim.
High: long buckles reaching far out.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crease_sharp:
Shape of the buckles.
0: soft waves.
1: knife-sharp folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crease_branch:
0 = clean straight folds, 1 = forked, broken folds.
Minimum: Clean straight folds, 1 = forked, broken folds.
Maximum: Forked, broken folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crumple:
Height of the small flat facets inside the dent.
0: a smooth dent.
High: a crumpled, faceted dent.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crumple_scale:
Size of those facets.
Low: fine crinkles.
High: big flat facets.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_roughness:
Fine hammered unevenness on the dented metal.
0: smooth metal.
High: a beaten, uneven surface.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_aim:
0 = toward the surface point nearest the empty,.
Nearest Surface: Nearest Surface.
Empty +Z: Empty +Z.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_proximity:
How far a crush empty may be from the metal and still act, compared with its radius.
Low: only empties at the surface crush.
High: empties farther away still crush, more weakly.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_depth:
How far the front of the crushed zone is pushed in.
Low: a light push.
High: the front is shoved deep in.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_length:
How long the crumple zone behind the pushed-in front is.
Low: a short crumple zone.
High: the crumpling runs far back.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_hinge:
Width of the fade at the sides of the crushed zone.
Low: a sharp sheared kink.
1: a wide, soft transition.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_skew:
How uneven the crush is from one side to the other.
0: an even, straight crush.
1: one side is crushed much more than the other.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_fold_size:
Distance between the folds in the crushed zone.
Low: many tight folds.
High: a few big folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_fold:
Height of the folds.
0: no folds.
1: the folds take up exactly the lost length. High: exaggerated folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_fold_sharp:
Shape of the folds.
0: soft waves.
1: knife-sharp folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_fold_wander:
0 = straight fold lines, 1 = wandering, diagonal folds.
Minimum: Straight fold lines, 1 = wandering, diagonal folds.
Maximum: Wandering, diagonal folds.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_fold_lift:
How much the folds lean outward so the panel tents up.
0: folds go in and out evenly.
High: folds mostly stick outward.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_crumple:
Height of the angular facets in the crushed zone.
0: smooth folds only.
High: strongly crumpled metal.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
ProjectDamageProps.metal_crush_facet:
Size of those angular facets.
Low: fine crinkles.
High: big flat facets.
Allowed range: no fixed minimum to no fixed maximum. The slider range is a working range, not a hard maximum.
